verses.hi: हे भारत! सभी प्राणी आरम्भ में अव्यक्त रहते हैं, बीच में व्यक्त होते हैं और अन्त में फिर अव्यक्त हो जाते हैं। फिर इसमें शोक की क्या बात है?

verses.sa:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन
माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।
आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति
श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्
verses.tr:
āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan
āśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ
āśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti
śhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit
verses.en: One sees this (the Self) as a wonder; another speaks of it as a wonder; another hears of it as a wonder; yet, having heard, none understands it at all.
verses.en2: One hears of the Spirit with surprise, another thinks it marvelous, the third listens without comprehending. Thus, though many are told about it, scarcely is there one who knows it.
verses.hi: कोई इस आत्मा को आश्चर्य की तरह देखता है, कोई इसका आश्चर्य की तरह वर्णन करता है, और कोई इसे आश्चर्य की तरह सुनता है; फिर भी सुनकर भी कोई इसे ठीक से नहीं जान पाता।

verses.sa:
देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।
तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.tr:
dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata
tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
wm: the soul that dwells within the body
verses.en: This indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible, O Arjuna; therefore, you should not grieve for any creature.
verses.en2: Do not be anxious about these armies; the spirit in man is imperishable.
verses.hi: हे भारत! सबके शरीर में रहने वाला यह आत्मा सदा अवध्य है; इसलिए तुम्हें किसी भी प्राणी के लिए शोक नहीं करना चाहिए।

verses.sa:
स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि।
धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते
verses.tr:
swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi
dharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate
wm: one’s duty in accordance with the Vedas
verses.en: Further, having regard to your duty, you should not waver, for there is nothing higher for a Kshatriya than a righteous war.
verses.en2: You must look at your duty. Nothing can be more welcome to a soldier than a righteous war. Therefore, wavering in this resolve is unworthy, O Arjuna!
verses.hi: अपने धर्म को देखते हुए भी तुम्हें विचलित नहीं होना चाहिए, क्योंकि क्षत्रिय के लिए धर्मयुक्त युद्ध से बढ़कर और कुछ कल्याणकारी नहीं है।

verses.sa:
यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।
सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्
verses.tr:
yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam
sukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham
verses.en: Happy are the Kshatriyas, O Arjuna! who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven.
verses.en2: Blessed are the soldiers who find their opportunity; this opportunity has opened for thee the gates of heaven.
verses.hi: हे पार्थ! वे क्षत्रिय भाग्यशाली हैं जिन्हें अपने-आप आया हुआ ऐसा युद्ध मिलता है, जो स्वर्ग के खुले द्वार के समान है।

verses.sa:
अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।
ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि
verses.tr:
atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi
tataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi
wm: one’s duty in accordance with the Vedas
verses.en: But if you will not fight this righteous war, then having abandoned your own duty and reputation, you will incur sin.
verses.en2: Refuse to fight in this righteous cause, and you will be a traitor, losing fame, incurring only sin.
verses.hi: परन्तु यदि तुम यह धर्मयुद्ध नहीं करोगे, तो अपने धर्म और कीर्ति को खोकर पाप के भागी बनोगे।

verses.sa:
अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।
संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते
verses.tr:
akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni
kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām
sambhāvitasya chākīrtir
maraṇād atirichyate
verses.en: People will also recount your everlasting dishonor; and for one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death.
verses.en2: Men will talk forever of thy disgrace; and to the noble, dishonor is worse than death.
verses.hi: लोग भी सदा तुम्हारी अपकीर्ति की चर्चा करेंगे; और सम्मानित व्यक्ति के लिए अपयश मृत्यु से भी बढ़कर है।

verses.sa:
भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।
येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्
verses.tr:
bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ
yeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
wm: warriors who could single handedly match the strength of ten thousand ordinary warriors
verses.en: The great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear, and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard.
verses.en2: Great generals will think that you have fled from the battlefield out of cowardice; though once honored, you will seem despicable.
verses.hi: महारथी समझेंगे कि तुम डर के कारण युद्ध से हट गए, और जो तुम्हें बहुत मान देते थे, उनकी दृष्टि में तुम छोटे हो जाओगे।

verses.sa:
अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।
निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्
verses.tr:
avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ
nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim
verses.en: Your enemies, scoffing at your power, will speak many abusive words—what could be more painful than this?
verses.en2: Your enemies will spread scandal and mock your courage. Is there anything more humiliating?
verses.hi: तुम्हारे शत्रु तुम्हारे सामर्थ्य की निन्दा करते हुए बहुत-सी न कहने योग्य बातें कहेंगे; इससे अधिक दुःखदायी और क्या होगा?

verses.sa:
हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः
verses.tr:
hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm
tasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ
verses.en: Slain, you will obtain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth; therefore, stand up, O son of Kunti, resolved to fight.
verses.en2: If you are killed, you will attain Heaven; if you are victorious, you will enjoy the kingdom of earth. Therefore, arise, O Son of Kunti, and fight!
verses.hi: यदि मारे गए तो स्वर्ग पाओगे, और जीत गए तो पृथ्वी का राज्य भोगोगे; इसलिए हे कुन्तीपुत्र, युद्ध का निश्चय करके उठ खड़े हो।

verses.sa:
सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ।
ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि
verses.tr:
sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau
tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi
verses.en: Having made pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat equal, engage in battle for the sake of battle; thus, you shall not incur sin.
verses.en2: Look upon pleasure and pain, victory and defeat, with an equal eye. Be prepared for the combat, and you will commit no sin.
verses.hi: सुख-दुःख, लाभ-हानि और जय-पराजय को समान समझकर युद्ध के लिए तैयार हो जाओ; ऐसा करने से तुम्हें पाप नहीं लगेगा।

verses.sa:
एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।
बुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि
verses.tr:
eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye
buddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha
karma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi
verses.en: This, which has been taught to you, is wisdom concerning Sankhya. Now listen to wisdom concerning Yoga, endowed with which, O Arjuna, you shall cast off the bonds of action.
verses.en2: I have told you the philosophy of knowledge. Now, listen, and I will explain the philosophy of action, by means of which, O Arjuna, you will break through the bondage of all action.
verses.hi: यह जो तुम्हें बताया गया, वह सांख्य का ज्ञान है। अब योग का ज्ञान सुनो, जिससे युक्त होकर हे पार्थ, तुम कर्म के बन्धन से छूट जाओगे।

verses.sa:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्
verses.tr:
nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate
svalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
verses.en: In this, there is no loss of effort, nor is there any harm produced, nor any transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear.
verses.en2: On this path, endeavour is never wasted nor repressed. Even a little practice of it protects one from great danger.
verses.hi: इस मार्ग में किया गया प्रयास कभी व्यर्थ नहीं जाता और इसमें कोई हानि या दोष भी नहीं है। इस धर्म का थोड़ा-सा पालन भी बड़े भय से रक्षा करता है।

verses.sa:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्
verses.tr:
vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana
bahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām
verses.en: Here, O joy of the Kurus, there is only one single-pointed determination; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive.
verses.en2: By its means, the straying intellect becomes steadied in contemplating one object only; whereas the minds of the irresolute stray into innumerable bypaths.
verses.hi: हे कुरुनन्दन! इस मार्ग में निश्चय करने वाली बुद्धि एक ही होती है; पर जिनका निश्चय नहीं है, उनकी बुद्धियाँ अनेक शाखाओं वाली और अनन्त होती हैं।

verses.sa:
यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।
वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः
verses.tr:
yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ
veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ
kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati
wm: attached to the flowery words of the Vedas
aiming to achieve the heavenly planets
verses.en: The unwise, taking pleasure in the eulogizing words of the Vedas, utter flowery speech, saying, "There is nothing else," O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Only the ignorant speak in figurative language; it is they who extol the letter of the scriptures, saying, "There is nothing deeper than this."
verses.hi: हे पार्थ! अविवेकी लोग वेदों के प्रशंसा-वचनों में रमे रहते हैं और "इसके अतिरिक्त कुछ नहीं है" कहते हुए लुभावनी बातें करते हैं।

verses.sa:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्।
क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति
verses.tr:
kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā
janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ
bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati
wm: resulting  in  fruitive    action, good        birth,     etc.
verses.en: Full of desires, with heaven as their goal, (they speak words that are directed to ends) leading to new births as the result of their works, and prescribe various methods abounding in specific actions, for the attainment of pleasure and power.
verses.en2: Consulting only their own desires, they construct their own heaven, devising arduous and complex rites to secure their own pleasure and power; and the only result is rebirth.
verses.hi: वे कामनाओं से भरे हैं और स्वर्ग को ही लक्ष्य मानते हैं; वे भोग और ऐश्वर्य पाने के लिए अनेक प्रकार के कर्मकाण्ड बताते हैं, जिनका फल फिर से जन्म है।

verses.sa:
भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते
verses.tr:
bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām
vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
verses.en: For those who are attached to pleasure and power, whose minds are drawn away by such teachings, their determinate reason is not formed which is steadily bent on meditation and Samadhi (superconscious state).
verses.en2: While their minds are absorbed with thoughts of power and personal enjoyment, they cannot focus their discrimination on one point.
verses.hi: जो भोग और ऐश्वर्य में आसक्त हैं और जिनका मन ऐसी बातों से खिंच गया है, उनकी निश्चयात्मक बुद्धि ध्यान और समाधि में स्थिर नहीं होती।

verses.sa:
त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन।
निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्
verses.tr:
trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna
nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān
wm: of the three modes of material nature
above the three modes of material nature, transcendental
verses.en: The Vedas deal with the three attributes; be thou above these three attributes. O Arjuna, free yourself from the pairs of opposites and ever remain in the quality of Sattva, freed from acquisition and preservation, and be established in the Self.
verses.en2: The Vedic Scriptures tell of the three constituents of life—the Qualities. Rise above all of them, O Arjuna, above all the pairs of opposing sensations; be steadfast in truth, free from worldly anxieties, and centered in the Self.
verses.hi: वेद तीनों गुणों के विषयों का वर्णन करते हैं; हे अर्जुन, तुम इन तीनों गुणों से ऊपर उठो। द्वन्द्वों से मुक्त होकर सदा सत्त्व में स्थित रहो, पाने और बचाने की चिन्ता छोड़ो और आत्मा में स्थित हो जाओ।

verses.sa:
यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके।
तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः
verses.tr:
yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake
tāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
wm: one who realizes the Absolute Truth
verses.en: To the Brahmana who has known the Self, all the Vedas are of as much use as a reservoir of water would be in a place where there is a flood.
verses.en2: As a man can drink water from any side of a full tank, so the skilled theologian can extract from any scripture that which will serve their purpose.
verses.hi: जहाँ चारों ओर बाढ़ का जल भरा हो, वहाँ एक छोटे जलाशय का जितना प्रयोजन रहता है, आत्मा को जानने वाले ब्राह्मण के लिए सब वेदों का उतना ही प्रयोजन रह जाता है।

verses.sa:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि
verses.tr:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi
verses.en: Your right is only to work, but not to its results; do not let the results of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
verses.en2: But you have only the right to work, but none to the fruit of it. Let not the fruit of your action be your motive; nor be you enamored of inaction.
verses.hi: तुम्हारा अधिकार केवल कर्म करने में है, उसके फलों में कभी नहीं। कर्म का फल तुम्हारी प्रेरणा न बने, और कर्म न करने में भी तुम्हारी आसक्ति न हो।

verses.sa:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
verses.tr:
yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate
verses.en: Perform action, O Arjuna, being steadfast in Yoga, abandoning attachment and balanced in success and failure; evenness of mind is called Yoga.
verses.en2: Perform all your actions with your mind concentrated on the Divine, renouncing attachment and looking upon success and failure with an equal eye. Spirituality implies equanimity.
verses.hi: हे धनंजय! योग में स्थित होकर, आसक्ति छोड़कर और सफलता-असफलता में समान रहकर कर्म करो; मन की यह समता ही योग कहलाती है।

verses.sa:
दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय।
बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः
verses.tr:
dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya
buddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ
wm: with the intellect established in Divine knowledge
those seeking fruits of their work
verses.en: Far lower than the Yoga of wisdom is action, O Arjuna. Seek thou refuge in wisdom; wretched are those whose motive is the fruit.
verses.en2: Physical action is far inferior to an intellect concentrated on the Divine. Therefore, have recourse to Pure Intelligence. It is only the small-minded who work for reward.
verses.hi: हे धनंजय! बुद्धियोग की तुलना में केवल कर्म बहुत नीचा है। तुम बुद्धि की शरण लो; फल के लिए कर्म करने वाले दीन हैं।

verses.sa:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
verses.tr:
buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite
tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam
verses.en: Endowed with wisdom and evenness of mind, one casts off in this life both good and evil deeds; therefore, devote yourself to Yoga; Yoga is skill in action.
verses.en2: When a person attains Pure Reason, they renounce in this world the results of both good and evil. Cling to Right Action. Spirituality is the true art of living.
verses.hi: समबुद्धि से युक्त मनुष्य इसी जीवन में पुण्य और पाप दोनों से मुक्त हो जाता है; इसलिए योग में लग जाओ। कर्म में कुशलता ही योग है।

verses.sa:
कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।
जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्
verses.tr:
karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ
janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam
wm: freedom from the bondage of life and death
verses.en: The wise, possessing knowledge, having abandoned the fruits of their actions, and being freed from the bonds of birth, go to the place which is beyond all evil.
verses.en2: The sages, guided by pure intellect, renounce the fruits of their actions; and, thus freed from the shackles of rebirth, they attain the highest bliss.
verses.hi: बुद्धि से युक्त ज्ञानी कर्मों के फल को त्यागकर जन्म के बन्धन से छूट जाते हैं और उस पद को पाते हैं जो सभी दुःखों से परे है।

verses.sa:
यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति।
तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च
verses.tr:
yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha
wm: to what is yet to be heard
verses.en: When your intellect passes beyond the mire of delusion, then you will attain indifference to what has been heard and what has yet to be heard.
verses.en2: When your reason has crossed the entanglements of illusion, then you will become indifferent to both the philosophies you have heard and those you may yet hear.
verses.hi: जब तुम्हारी बुद्धि मोह के दलदल को पार कर लेगी, तब तुम जो सुन चुके हो और जो अभी सुनना है, उन सबसे विरक्त हो जाओगे।

verses.sa:
श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।
समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि
verses.tr:
śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā
samādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi
wm: not allured by the fruitive sections of the Vedas
verses.en: When your intellect, which is perplexed by the Vedic texts you have read, stands immovable and steady in the Self, then you will attain Self-realization.
verses.en2: When the intellect, bewildered by the multiplicity of holy scriptures, stands unperturbed in blissful contemplation of the infinite, then you have attained spirituality.
verses.hi: अनेक वैदिक वचनों को सुनकर भ्रमित हुई तुम्हारी बुद्धि जब आत्मा में अचल और स्थिर हो जाएगी, तब तुम योग को प्राप्त कर लोगे।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव।
स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
sthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava
sthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim
wm: Shree Krishna, killer of the Keshi Demon
verses.en: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, what is the description of one who has steady wisdom and is merged in the superconscious state? How does one of steady wisdom speak, how do they sit, and how do they walk?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked: My Lord! How can we recognize the saint who has attained Pure Intellect, who has reached this state of Bliss, and whose mind is steady? How does he talk, how does he live, and how does he act?
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे केशव! समाधि में स्थित, स्थिर बुद्धि वाले मनुष्य के क्या लक्षण हैं? स्थिर बुद्धि वाला कैसे बोलता है, कैसे बैठता है और कैसे चलता है?

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān
ātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "When a man completely casts off, O Arjuna, all the desires of the mind and is satisfied in the Self by the Self, then he is said to be one of steady wisdom."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: When a person has given up the desires of their heart and is content with the Self alone, they have surely reached the highest state.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे पार्थ! जब मनुष्य मन की सारी कामनाओं को पूरी तरह त्याग देता है और आत्मा से आत्मा में ही सन्तुष्ट रहता है, तब वह स्थितप्रज्ञ कहलाता है।

verses.sa:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते
verses.tr:
duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate
verses.en: He whose mind is not shaken by adversity, who does not long for pleasures, and is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady wisdom.
verses.en2: The sage whose mind is unruffled in suffering, whose desire is not aroused by enjoyment, who is without attachment, anger, or fear—take him to be one who stands at a lofty level.
verses.hi: जिसका मन दुःखों में विचलित नहीं होता, जो सुखों की लालसा नहीं रखता और जो राग, भय और क्रोध से मुक्त है, वह स्थिर बुद्धि वाला मुनि कहलाता है।

verses.sa:
यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्।
नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.tr:
yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham
nābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.en: He who is everywhere without attachment, upon encountering anything good or bad, neither rejoices nor hastens; his wisdom is firm.
verses.en2: He who, wherever he goes, is not attached to any person or place by ties of flesh; who accepts good and evil alike, neither welcoming the one nor shrinking from the other—take him to be one who is merged in the Infinite.
verses.hi: जो सर्वत्र आसक्ति-रहित है और शुभ या अशुभ कुछ भी मिलने पर न प्रसन्न होता है, न द्वेष करता है, उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर है।

verses.sa:
यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.tr:
yadā sanharate chāyaṁ kūrmo ’ṅgānīva sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.en: When, like the tortoise which withdraws all its limbs on all sides, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, then his wisdom becomes steady.
verses.en2: He who can withdraw his senses from the attraction of their objects, as the tortoise draws its limbs within its shell—take it that such a one has attained perfection.
verses.hi: जैसे कछुआ अपने अंगों को सब ओर से समेट लेता है, वैसे ही जब मनुष्य अपनी इन्द्रियों को विषयों से हटा लेता है, तब उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर होती है।

verses.sa:
विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः।
रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते
verses.tr:
viṣhayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ
rasa-varjaṁ raso ’pyasya paraṁ dṛiṣhṭvā nivartate
verses.en: The objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent man, leaving the longing behind; but his longing also turns away upon seeing the Supreme.
verses.en2: The objects of sense turn away from him who is abstinent. Even the taste for them is lost in him who has seen the Truth.
verses.hi: जो विषयों का सेवन नहीं करता, उससे विषय तो हट जाते हैं, पर उनकी लालसा बनी रहती है; परमात्मा का साक्षात्कार होने पर वह लालसा भी मिट जाती है।

verses.sa:
यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः।
इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः
verses.tr:
yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣhasya vipaśhchitaḥ
indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṁ manaḥ
verses.en: The turbulent senses, O Arjuna, can violently carry away the mind of a wise person, even though they are striving to control them.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! The mind of one who is attempting to conquer it is forcibly carried away, in spite of their efforts, by their tumultuous senses.
verses.hi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र! प्रयत्न करने वाले विवेकी पुरुष के मन को भी ये प्रबल इन्द्रियाँ बलपूर्वक हर लेती हैं।

verses.sa:
तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।
वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.tr:
tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
vaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.en: Having restrained them all, he should sit steadfast, intent on Me; his wisdom is steady whose senses are under control.
verses.en2: Restraining them all, let him steadfastly meditate on Me; for whoever conquers their senses achieves perfection.
verses.hi: इन सब इन्द्रियों को वश में करके मनुष्य मुझमें मन लगाकर स्थिर बैठे; जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ वश में हैं, उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर है।

verses.sa:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते
verses.tr:
dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate
verses.en: When one thinks of objects, attachment to them arises; from attachment, desire is born; from desire, anger arises.
verses.en2: When a person dwells on the objects of sense, they create an attraction for them; this attraction develops into desire, and desire breeds anger.
verses.hi: विषयों का चिन्तन करने से उनमें आसक्ति उत्पन्न होती है; आसक्ति से कामना जन्म लेती है, और कामना से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है।

verses.sa:
क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः।
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति
verses.tr:
krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛiti-vibhramaḥ
smṛiti-bhranśhād buddhi-nāśho buddhi-nāśhāt praṇaśhyati
verses.en: Anger leads to delusion, which causes loss of memory; this, in turn, leads to the destruction of discrimination, resulting in destruction.
verses.en2: Anger induces delusion; delusion leads to loss of memory; loss of memory results in the shattering of reason; and the destruction of reason leads to destruction.
verses.hi: क्रोध से मोह होता है, मोह से स्मृति भ्रमित हो जाती है, स्मृति के भ्रम से बुद्धि (विवेक) का नाश होता है, और बुद्धि के नाश से मनुष्य का पतन हो जाता है।

verses.sa:
रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्।
आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
rāga-dveṣha-viyuktais tu viṣhayān indriyaiśh charan
ātma-vaśhyair-vidheyātmā prasādam adhigachchhati
verses.en: But the self-controlled man, moving among objects with the senses restrained and free from attraction and repulsion, attains peace.
verses.en2: But the self-controlled soul, who moves among sense objects, free from attachment or repulsion, wins eternal peace.
verses.hi: पर संयमी मनुष्य राग और द्वेष से मुक्त, वश में की हुई इन्द्रियों के साथ विषयों के बीच विचरता हुआ भी शान्ति को प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa:
प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते।
प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते
verses.tr:
prasāde sarva-duḥkhānāṁ hānir asyopajāyate
prasanna-chetaso hyāśhu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣhṭhate
verses.en: In that peace, all pains are destroyed; for the intellect of the tranquil-minded soon becomes steady.
verses.en2: Having attained peace, he becomes free from misery; for when the mind gains peace, right discrimination follows.
verses.hi: उस शान्ति में उसके सभी दुःख नष्ट हो जाते हैं; क्योंकि प्रसन्न चित्त वाले की बुद्धि शीघ्र ही स्थिर हो जाती है।

verses.sa:
नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना।
न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्
verses.tr:
nāsti buddhir-ayuktasya na chāyuktasya bhāvanā
na chābhāvayataḥ śhāntir aśhāntasya kutaḥ sukham
verses.en: There is no knowledge of the Self for the unsteady, and no meditation is possible for the unsteady, and no peace for the unmeditative, and how can there be happiness for one who has no peace?
verses.en2: Right discrimination is not for him who cannot concentrate. Without concentration, there cannot be meditation; he who cannot meditate must not expect peace; and without peace, how can one expect happiness?
verses.hi: अस्थिर मन वाले को आत्मज्ञान नहीं होता, न वह ध्यान कर सकता है; ध्यान न करने वाले को शान्ति नहीं मिलती, और जिसे शान्ति नहीं, उसे सुख कैसे मिल सकता है?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते।
तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि
verses.tr:
indriyāṇāṁ hi charatāṁ yan mano ’nuvidhīyate
tadasya harati prajñāṁ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi
verses.en: For the mind, which follows in the wake of the wandering senses, carries away his discrimination, as the wind carries away a boat on the waters.
verses.en2: As a ship at sea is tossed by the tempest, so the reason is carried away by the mind when preyed upon by straying senses.
verses.hi: क्योंकि भटकती इन्द्रियों के पीछे चलने वाला मन मनुष्य के विवेक को वैसे ही हर लेता है, जैसे हवा जल में नाव को बहा ले जाती है।

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.tr:
tasmād yasya mahā-bāho nigṛihītāni sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.en: Therefore, O mighty-armed Arjuna, his knowledge is steady whose senses are completely restrained from sense objects.
verses.en2: Therefore, O Mighty-Armed One, he whose senses are detached from their objects—take it that his reason is purified.
verses.hi: इसलिए हे महाबाहो, जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ विषयों से पूरी तरह वश में कर ली गई हैं, उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर है।

verses.sa:
या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी।
यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः
verses.tr:
yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī
yasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśhā paśhyato muneḥ
verses.en: That which is night to all beings, in that the self-controlled man is awake; when all beings are awake, that is night for the sage who sees.
verses.en2: The saint is awake when the world sleeps, and he disregards that for which the world lives.
verses.hi: जो सब प्राणियों के लिए रात है, उसमें संयमी पुरुष जागता है; और जिसमें सब प्राणी जागते हैं, वह तत्त्व को देखने वाले मुनि के लिए रात है।

verses.sa:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं
समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे
स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी
verses.tr:
āpūryamāṇam achala-pratiṣhṭhaṁ
samudram āpaḥ praviśhanti yadvat
tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśhanti sarve
sa śhāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī
wm: one who strives to satisfy desires
verses.en: He attains peace into whom all desires enter, just as waters enter the ocean which, filled from all sides, remains unmoved; but not the man who is full of desires.
verses.en2: He attains peace into whom desires flow as rivers into the ocean, which, though brimming with water, remains ever the same; not he whom desires carry away.
verses.hi: जैसे सब ओर से भरे हुए, अचल समुद्र में नदियों का जल आकर समा जाता है और वह विचलित नहीं होता, वैसे ही जिसमें सारी कामनाएँ समा जाती हैं, वही शान्ति पाता है; कामनाओं के पीछे भागने वाला नहीं।

verses.sa:
विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः।
निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ
nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sa śhāntim adhigachchhati
verses.en: That person attains peace who, abandoning all desires, moves about without longing, without the sense of ownership, and without egoism.
verses.en2: He attains peace who, giving up desire, moves through the world without aspiration, possessing nothing that he can call his own and is free from pride.
verses.hi: जो मनुष्य सारी कामनाओं को छोड़कर लालसा, ममता और अहंकार से रहित होकर विचरता है, वही शान्ति को प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa:
एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति।
स्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति
verses.tr:
eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati
sthitvāsyām anta-kāle ’pi brahma-nirvāṇam ṛichchhati
verses.en: O son of Pritha, this is the eternal state, the Brahmic seat. Attaining this, one is not deluded. Being established in it, one attains oneness with Brahman even at the end of life.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! This is the state of the Self, the Supreme Spirit, to which, if one attains, it shall never be taken away. Even at the time of leaving the body, one will remain firmly enthroned there and become one with the Eternal.
verses.hi: हे पार्थ! यही शाश्वत, ब्राह्मी स्थिति है। इसे पाकर मनुष्य मोहित नहीं होता। अन्तकाल में भी इसमें स्थित रहकर वह ब्रह्म में लीन हो जाता है।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
jyāyasī chet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana
tat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśhava
wm: he who looks after the public, Krishna
Krishna, the killer of the demon named Keshi
verses.en: Arjuna said: If Thou thinkest that knowledge is superior to action, O Krishna, why then, O Kesava, doest Thou ask me to engage in this terrible action?
verses.en2: Arjuna questioned: My Lord! If wisdom is superior to action, why do you advise me to engage in this terrible fight?
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे जनार्दन! यदि आप ज्ञान को कर्म से श्रेष्ठ मानते हैं, तो हे केशव, आप मुझे इस भयंकर कर्म में क्यों लगा रहे हैं?

verses.sa:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे।
तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्
verses.tr:
vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me
tad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām
verses.en: With this seemingly perplexing speech, you seem to be confusing my understanding; therefore, tell me one certain way by which I may attain bliss.
verses.en2: Your language confuses me and confounds my reason. Therefore, please tell me the only way by which I can, without doubt, secure my spiritual welfare.
verses.hi: इन मिले-जुले से लगने वाले वचनों से आप मानो मेरी बुद्धि को उलझा रहे हैं; इसलिए मुझे निश्चित रूप से एक ही मार्ग बताइए, जिससे मैं कल्याण पा सकूँ।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ।
ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
loke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "In this world, there is a twofold path, as I said before, O sinless one: the path of knowledge of the Sankhyas and the path of action of the Yogins."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: In this world, as I have said, there is a twofold path, O sinless one! There is the path of wisdom for those who meditate, and the path of action for those who work.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे निष्पाप अर्जुन! जैसा मैंने पहले कहा, इस संसार में दो प्रकार की निष्ठा है: सांख्यों के लिए ज्ञानयोग और योगियों के लिए कर्मयोग।

verses.sa:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।
न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute
na cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati
verses.en: Man does not reach actionlessness by not performing actions; nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation.
verses.en2: No one can attain freedom from action by abstaining from action, nor can they reach perfection by simply not acting.
verses.hi: कर्मों को न करने से मनुष्य निष्कर्मता को नहीं पाता, और केवल त्याग कर देने से सिद्धि प्राप्त नहीं होती।

verses.sa:
न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।
कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः
verses.tr:
na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit
kāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ
verses.en: Verily, no one can remain for even a moment without performing action; for everyone is made to act helplessly, indeed, by the qualities born of Nature.
verses.en2: He cannot remain inactive even for a moment, for the qualities of Nature will compel him to act, whether he wills it or not.
verses.hi: निश्चय ही कोई भी एक क्षण भी कर्म किए बिना नहीं रह सकता; क्योंकि प्रकृति से उत्पन्न गुण सबको विवश होकर कर्म करने में लगाते हैं।

verses.sa:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।
इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते
verses.tr:
karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran
indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate
verses.en: He who, restraining the organs of action, sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind, he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite.
verses.en2: He who remains motionless, refusing to act, yet brooding over sensuous objects, is that deluded soul simply a hypocrite.
verses.hi: जो कर्मेन्द्रियों को रोककर मन में इन्द्रियों के विषयों का चिन्तन करता रहता है, वह भ्रमित बुद्धि वाला मनुष्य पाखण्डी कहलाता है।

verses.sa:
यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।
कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते
verses.tr:
yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna
karmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate
verses.en: But whoever, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, engages himself in Karma Yoga with the organs of action, without attachment, he excels.
verses.en2: But, O Arjuna! All honor to him whose mind controls his senses, for he is thereby beginning to practice Karma-Yoga, the Path of Right Action, keeping himself always unattached.
verses.hi: पर हे अर्जुन! जो मन से इन्द्रियों को वश में करके, आसक्ति के बिना, कर्मेन्द्रियों द्वारा कर्मयोग का आचरण करता है, वही श्रेष्ठ है।

verses.sa:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः
verses.tr:
niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
śharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ
verses.en: Perform your bounden duty, for action is superior to inaction, and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction.
verses.en2: Do your duty as prescribed, for action for duty's sake is superior to inaction. Even the maintenance of the body would be impossible if one remained inactive.
verses.hi: तुम अपना नियत कर्तव्य करो, क्योंकि कर्म न करने से कर्म करना श्रेष्ठ है; कर्म न करने से तो तुम्हारे शरीर का निर्वाह भी नहीं हो सकेगा।

verses.sa:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः।
तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर
verses.tr:
yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ
tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara
verses.en: The world is bound by actions other than those performed for the sake of sacrifice; do thou, therefore, O son of Kunti (Arjuna), perform actions for that sake alone, free from attachment.
verses.en2: In this world, people are fettered by their actions, unless they are performed as a sacrifice. Therefore, O Arjuna, let your actions be done without attachment, as a sacrifice only.
verses.hi: यज्ञ के लिए किए जाने वाले कर्मों के अतिरिक्त अन्य कर्मों से यह संसार बँधता है; इसलिए हे कुन्तीपुत्र, आसक्ति छोड़कर केवल यज्ञ के लिए ही कर्म करो।

verses.sa:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।
अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्
verses.tr:
saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk
verses.en: The Creator, having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice, said, "By this shall you propagate; let this be the milch cow of your desires—the cow that yields all the desired objects."
verses.en2: In the beginning, when God created all beings through the sacrifice of Himself, He said to them: "You can procreate through sacrifice, and it shall satisfy all your desires."
verses.hi: प्रजापति ने सृष्टि के आरम्भ में यज्ञ के साथ मनुष्यों को रचकर कहा: "इसके द्वारा तुम्हारी वृद्धि हो; यह तुम्हारे लिए कामधेनु बने, जो सभी इच्छित वस्तुएँ देती है।"

verses.sa:
देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।
परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ
verses.tr:
devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
parasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha
verses.en: With this, nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you; thus, nourishing each other, you shall attain the highest good.
verses.en2: Worship the powers of Nature, and let them nourish you in return; thus, supporting each other, you shall attain your highest welfare.
verses.hi: इस यज्ञ से तुम देवताओं को पुष्ट करो, और देवता तुम्हें पुष्ट करें; इस प्रकार एक-दूसरे को पुष्ट करते हुए तुम परम कल्याण पाओगे।

verses.sa:
इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।
तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः
verses.tr:
iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ
tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
verses.en: The gods, nourished by the sacrifice, will give you the desired objects. So, he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief.
verses.en2: For, fed by sacrifice, nature will give you all the enjoyment you desire. But he who enjoys what she gives without returning is, indeed, a thief.
verses.hi: यज्ञ से पुष्ट हुए देवता तुम्हें इच्छित भोग देंगे। जो उनके दिए हुए भोगों को बदले में उन्हें कुछ अर्पित किए बिना भोगता है, वह निश्चय ही चोर है।

verses.sa:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।
भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्
verses.tr:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt
wm: of remnants of food offered in sacrifice
verses.en: The righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins; but those sinful ones who cook food solely for their own sake indeed consume sin.
verses.en2: The sages who enjoy the food that remains after the sacrifice is made are freed from all sins; whereas, the selfish who spread their feast only for themselves feed on sin alone.
verses.hi: यज्ञ से बचे हुए अन्न को खाने वाले सज्जन सब पापों से छूट जाते हैं; पर जो पापी केवल अपने लिए ही भोजन पकाते हैं, वे तो पाप ही खाते हैं।

verses.sa:
अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।
यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः
verses.tr:
annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ
yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ
verses.en: From food come forth beings; from rain, food is produced; from sacrifice arises rain, and sacrifice is born of action.
verses.en2: All creatures are the product of food; food is the product of rain; rain comes from sacrifice, and sacrifice is the noblest form of action.
verses.hi: अन्न से प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं, वर्षा से अन्न पैदा होता है, यज्ञ से वर्षा होती है और यज्ञ कर्म से उत्पन्न होता है।

verses.sa:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।
तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.tr:
karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam
tasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam
verses.en: Know that action comes from Brahma, and Brahma comes from the Imperishable. Therefore, the all-pervasive Brahma ever rests in sacrifice.
verses.en2: All actions originate from the Supreme Spirit, which is Imperishable, and in sacrificial actions, the all-pervasive Spirit is consciously present.
verses.hi: जानो कि कर्म ब्रह्मा (वेद) से उत्पन्न होता है और ब्रह्मा अविनाशी से उत्पन्न होता है। इसलिए सर्वव्यापी ब्रह्म सदा यज्ञ में प्रतिष्ठित है।

verses.sa:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः।
अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति
verses.tr:
evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ
aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati
wm: for the delight of their senses
verses.en: He who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion, who is of sinful life, rejoicing in the senses, lives in vain, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Thus, he who does not help the revolving wheel of sacrifice, but instead leads a sinful life, rejoicing in the gratification of his senses, O Arjuna, is breathing in vain.
verses.hi: हे पार्थ! जो इस प्रकार चलाए गए चक्र का अनुसरण नहीं करता, वह पापमय जीवन वाला और इन्द्रियों में रमने वाला मनुष्य व्यर्थ ही जीता है।

verses.sa:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः।
आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते
verses.tr:
yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ
ātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate
verses.en: But for that man who rejoices only in the Self, who is satisfied with the Self and is content in the Self alone, indeed there is nothing to do.
verses.en2: On the other hand, the soul who meditates on the Self is content to serve the Self and rests satisfied in the Self; there is nothing more for them to accomplish.
verses.hi: पर जो मनुष्य आत्मा में ही रमता है, आत्मा से ही तृप्त है और आत्मा में ही सन्तुष्ट है, उसके लिए करने को कुछ भी शेष नहीं रहता।

verses.sa:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन।
न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः
verses.tr:
naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana
na chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ
verses.en: For him, there is no interest whatsoever in what is done or not done; nor does he depend on any being for any purpose.
verses.en2: He has nothing to gain from the performance or non-performance of action; his welfare does not depend on any contribution that an earthly creature can make.
verses.hi: उसके लिए इस संसार में न कुछ करने से कोई प्रयोजन है, न न करने से; और न उसे किसी प्राणी पर किसी प्रयोजन के लिए निर्भर रहना पड़ता है।

verses.sa:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः
verses.tr:
tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ
verses.en: Therefore, without attachment, always perform the actions that should be done; for by performing actions without attachment, one reaches the Supreme.
verses.en2: Therefore, do your duty perfectly, without worrying about the results, for he who does his duty without attachment attains the Supreme.
verses.hi: इसलिए आसक्ति के बिना सदा अपने कर्तव्य-कर्म करते रहो; क्योंकि आसक्ति के बिना कर्म करने से मनुष्य परमात्मा को प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः।
लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.tr:
karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ
loka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi
wm: by the performance of prescribed duties
for the welfare of the masses
verses.en: Janaka and others attained perfection indeed through action alone; even with the intention of protecting the masses, you should perform action.
verses.en2: King Janaka and others attained perfection through action alone. Even for the sake of enlightening the world, it is your duty to act.
verses.hi: जनक आदि ने कर्म के द्वारा ही सिद्धि प्राप्त की थी; लोक-संग्रह (जनसाधारण के हित) को ध्यान में रखकर भी तुम्हें कर्म करना चाहिए।

verses.sa:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते
verses.tr:
yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ
sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate
verses.en: Whatever a great man does, others also do; whatever he establishes as the standard, the world follows.
verses.en2: For whatever a great man does, others imitate; people conform to the standard he has set.
verses.hi: श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य जैसा आचरण करता है, दूसरे लोग भी वैसा ही करते हैं; वह जो मानदण्ड स्थापित करता है, संसार उसी का अनुसरण करता है।

verses.sa:
न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।
नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि
verses.tr:
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana
nānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi
verses.en: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Arjuna, that needs to be done by Me, nor is there anything unattained that needs to be attained; yet I engage Myself in action.
verses.en2: There is nothing in this universe, O Arjuna, that I am compelled to do, nor anything for me to attain; yet I persistently remain active.
verses.hi: हे पार्थ! तीनों लोकों में मेरे लिए कुछ भी करना शेष नहीं है, और न कोई ऐसी वस्तु है जो मुझे प्राप्त न हो और प्राप्त करनी हो; फिर भी मैं कर्म में लगा रहता हूँ।

verses.sa:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
verses.tr:
yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
wm: in the performance of prescribed duties
verses.en: For, should I not ever engage myself in action, unwearied, people would in every way follow my path, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Were I not to act without ceasing, O prince, people would be inclined to do the same.
verses.hi: क्योंकि हे पार्थ, यदि मैं कभी बिना थके कर्म में न लगा रहूँ, तो लोग सब प्रकार से मेरे ही मार्ग का अनुसरण करेंगे।

verses.sa:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।
सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः
verses.tr:
utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham
sankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.en: These worlds would perish if I did not perform action; I would be the author of confusion of castes and destruction of these beings.
verses.en2: And if I were to refrain from action, the human race would be ruined; I would lead the world to chaos, and destruction would follow.
verses.hi: यदि मैं कर्म न करूँ तो ये सब लोक नष्ट हो जाएँ; मैं वर्णसंकर का कारण बनूँ और इन प्रजाओं के विनाश का भी।

verses.sa:
सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत।
कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्
verses.tr:
saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata
kuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham
verses.en: As the ignorant act out of attachment to action, O Bharata, so should the wise act without attachment, wishing for the welfare of the world.
verses.en2: As the ignorant act, out of their fondness for action, so should the wise act without attachment, fixing their eyes, O Arjuna, only on the welfare of the world.
verses.hi: हे भारत! जैसे अज्ञानी लोग कर्म में आसक्त होकर कर्म करते हैं, वैसे ही ज्ञानी को संसार के कल्याण की इच्छा से, आसक्ति के बिना कर्म करना चाहिए।

verses.sa:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्।
जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्
verses.tr:
na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām
joṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan
wm: who are attached to fruitive actions
verses.en: Let no wise man unsettle the minds of ignorant people who are attached to action; he should engage them in all actions, himself fulfilling them with devotion.
verses.en2: But a wise man should not disturb the minds of the ignorant, who are attached to action; let him perform his own actions in the right spirit, with concentration on Me, thus inspiring all others to do the same.
verses.hi: ज्ञानी पुरुष कर्म में आसक्त अज्ञानी लोगों की बुद्धि में भ्रम उत्पन्न न करे; बल्कि स्वयं भली-भाँति कर्म करते हुए उन्हें भी सब कर्मों में लगाए रखे।

verses.sa:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते
verses.tr:
prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ
ahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate
wm: those who are bewildered by the ego and misidentify themselves with the body
verses.en: All actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of Nature alone. He whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks, "I am the doer."
verses.en2: Action is the product of the qualities inherent in nature. It is only the ignorant man who, misled by personal egotism, says, "I am the doer."
verses.hi: सब प्रकार के कर्म प्रकृति के गुणों द्वारा ही किए जाते हैं। पर अहंकार से मोहित मन वाला मनुष्य सोचता है, "मैं कर्ता हूँ।"

verses.sa:
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः।
गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते
verses.tr:
tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
wm: modes of material nature in the shape of the senses, mind, etc
modes of material nature in the shape of objects of perception
verses.en: But he who knows the Truth, O mighty-armed Arjuna, about the divisions of the qualities and their functions, knowing that the Gunas, as senses, move amidst the Gunas, as the sense-objects, is not attached.
verses.en2: But he, O Mighty One, who correctly understands the relationship between the Qualities and action, is not attached to the act, for he perceives that it is merely the action and reaction of the Qualities among themselves.
verses.hi: पर हे महाबाहो! जो गुणों और कर्मों के विभाग का तत्त्व जानता है, वह यह समझकर कि इन्द्रियों के रूप में गुण ही विषयों के रूप में गुणों में बरत रहे हैं, आसक्त नहीं होता।

verses.sa:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।
तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्
verses.tr:
prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu
tān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet
wm: by the modes of material nature
verses.en: Those deluded by the qualities of Nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. The man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish one who is of imperfect knowledge.
verses.en2: Those who do not understand the qualities are interested in the act; however, the wise man who knows the truth should not disturb the mind of those who do not.
verses.hi: प्रकृति के गुणों से मोहित लोग गुणों के कर्मों में आसक्त रहते हैं। पूर्ण ज्ञान वाले मनुष्य को अधूरे ज्ञान वाले उन मन्दबुद्धि लोगों को विचलित नहीं करना चाहिए।

verses.sa:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।
निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः
verses.tr:
mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā
nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ
wm: with the thoughts resting on God
free from hankering for the results of the actions
verses.en: Renouncing all actions in Me, with the mind centered on the Self, free from hope and egoism, and from mental fever, fight thou.
verses.en2: Therefore, surrender your actions to Me, keep your thoughts focused on the Absolute, free from selfishness and without expecting a reward, with a mind free from excitement, begin to fight.
verses.hi: सारे कर्म मुझे अर्पित करके, मन को आत्मा में लगाकर, आशा, ममता और मानसिक सन्ताप से मुक्त होकर तुम युद्ध करो।

verses.sa:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः।
श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः
verses.tr:
ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ
śhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ
verses.en: Those who constantly practice this teaching of Mine with faith and without caviling, they too are freed from actions.
verses.en2: Those who always act in accordance with My precepts, firmly in faith and without caviling, they too are freed from the bondage of action.
verses.hi: जो मनुष्य श्रद्धा के साथ और दोष निकाले बिना मेरे इस उपदेश का सदा पालन करते हैं, वे भी कर्मों के बन्धन से छूट जाते हैं।

verses.sa:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्।
सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः
verses.tr:
ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam
sarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ
verses.en: But those who criticize My teaching and do not practice it, deprived of all knowledge and lacking discernment, know them to be doomed to destruction.
verses.en2: But they who ridicule My word and do not observe it, are ignorant, devoid of wisdom, and blind. They seek only their own destruction.
verses.hi: पर जो मेरे उपदेश में दोष निकालते हैं और उसका पालन नहीं करते, उन्हें सब ज्ञान से वंचित, विवेकहीन और नष्ट हुआ ही समझो।

verses.sa:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि।
प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति
verses.tr:
sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api
prakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati
verses.en: Even a wise man acts in accordance with his own nature; beings will follow their nature; what can restraint do?
verses.en2: Even the wise man acts in accordance with his nature; indeed, all creatures act according to their natures. What is the use of compulsion then?
verses.hi: ज्ञानी भी अपनी प्रकृति के अनुसार ही आचरण करता है; सभी प्राणी अपनी प्रकृति का ही अनुसरण करते हैं; फिर हठपूर्वक रोकने से क्या होगा?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ।
तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ
verses.tr:
indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau
tayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau
verses.en: Attachment and aversion for the objects of the senses abide in the senses; let no one come under their sway; for, they are his enemies.
verses.en2: The love and hate that are aroused by the objects of sense arise from Nature; do not yield to them, as they only obstruct the path.
verses.hi: हर इन्द्रिय के विषय में राग और द्वेष छिपे रहते हैं; मनुष्य को इनके वश में नहीं होना चाहिए, क्योंकि ये उसके शत्रु हैं।

verses.sa:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः
verses.tr:
śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
swa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ
verses.en: Better is one's own duty, though devoid of merit, than the duty of another well discharged. Better is death in one's own duty; the duty of another is fraught with fear.
verses.en2: It is better to do one's own duty, however lacking in merit, than to do that of another, even though efficiently. It is better to die doing one's own duty, for doing the duty of another is fraught with danger.
verses.hi: दूसरे के धर्म को भली-भाँति निभाने से अपना धर्म, गुणों में कम होने पर भी, श्रेष्ठ है। अपने धर्म में मरना भी अच्छा है; दूसरे का धर्म भय से भरा है।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।
अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
atha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ
anichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ
wm: he who belongs to the Vrishni clan, Shree Krishna
verses.en: Arjuna said, "But what compels man to commit sin, even against his wishes, O Varshneya (Krishna), as if constrained by force?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is it that drives a person to sin, even against their will and as if by compulsion?"
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे वार्ष्णेय! तो फिर मनुष्य न चाहते हुए भी, मानो बलपूर्वक विवश किया गया हो, किसकी प्रेरणा से पाप करता है?

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः।
महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ
mahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "It is desire and it is anger, both of the quality of Rajas, all-devouring and all-sinful; know this as the foe here in this world."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna: It is desire, it is aversion, born of passion. Desire consumes and corrupts all things. It is the greatest enemy of man.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: यह काम है, यह क्रोध है, जो रजोगुण से उत्पन्न होते हैं; ये सब कुछ निगल जाने वाले और महापापी हैं। इस संसार में इसे ही शत्रु जानो।

verses.sa:
धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च।
यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्
verses.tr:
dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha
yatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam
verses.en: As fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and as an embryo is surrounded by the amniotic sac, so is this enveloped by that.
verses.en2: As fire is shrouded by smoke, a mirror is covered by dust, and a child is enveloped by the womb, so is the universe enveloped in desire.
verses.hi: जैसे धुएँ से आग ढकी रहती है, धूल से दर्पण ढका रहता है और जेर (झिल्ली) से गर्भ ढका रहता है, वैसे ही इस काम से यह ज्ञान ढका रहता है।

verses.sa:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।
कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च
verses.tr:
āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā
kāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha
verses.en: O Arjuna, wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise, in the form of desire, which is insatiable like fire.
verses.en2: It is the wise man's constant enemy; it tarnishes the face of wisdom, being as insatiable as a flame of fire.
verses.hi: हे कौन्तेय! ज्ञानियों के इस नित्य शत्रु, कामना के रूप वाले और आग के समान कभी तृप्त न होने वाले काम से ज्ञान ढका हुआ है।

verses.sa:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।
एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्
verses.tr:
indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate
etair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam
verses.en: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its seat; through these, it deludes the embodied one, veiling their wisdom.
verses.en2: It works through the senses, the mind, and the reason; and with their help, it destroys wisdom and confounds the soul.
verses.hi: इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि इसके निवास-स्थान कहे जाते हैं; इन्हीं के द्वारा यह ज्ञान को ढककर देहधारी को मोहित करता है।

verses.sa:
तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।
पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्
verses.tr:
tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha
pāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam
wm: Arjun, the best of the Bharatas
verses.en: Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing, which destroys knowledge and realization.
verses.en2: Therefore, O Arjuna, first control your senses and then slay desire, for it is full of sin and is the destroyer of knowledge and wisdom.
verses.hi: इसलिए हे भरतश्रेष्ठ! पहले अपनी इन्द्रियों को वश में करो, और फिर ज्ञान और विज्ञान का नाश करने वाले इस पापी काम को मार डालो।

verses.sa:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।
मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः
verses.tr:
indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ
manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ
verses.en: They say that the senses are superior to the body; the mind is superior to the senses; the intellect is superior to the mind; and He (the Self) is superior even to the intellect.
verses.en2: It is said that the senses are powerful; however, beyond the senses is the mind, beyond the mind is the intellect, and greater than the intellect is He.
verses.hi: कहते हैं कि इन्द्रियाँ शरीर से श्रेष्ठ हैं, इन्द्रियों से मन श्रेष्ठ है, मन से बुद्धि श्रेष्ठ है, और जो बुद्धि से भी श्रेष्ठ है वह आत्मा है।

verses.sa:
एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।
जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्
verses.tr:
evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā
jahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam
wm: the lower self (senses, mind, and intellect)
verses.en: Thus, knowing Him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the Self, slay thou, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the enemy in the form of desire, hard to conquer.
verses.en2: Thus, O Mighty-Armed One, knowing Him to be beyond the intellect, and with His help, subdue your personal ego and kill your enemy, Desire, even though it is extremely difficult.
verses.hi: इस प्रकार बुद्धि से भी श्रेष्ठ आत्मा को जानकर और आत्मा द्वारा मन को वश में करके, हे महाबाहो, इस कामरूपी दुर्जय शत्रु को मार डालो।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।
विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt
wm: the Supreme Lord Shree Krishna said
to Manu, the original progenitor of humankind
to Ikshvaku, first king of the Solar dynasty
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; he then told it to Manu; Manu proclaimed it to Ikshvaku.
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna said: I taught this imperishable philosophy to Vivaswān, the founder of the Sun dynasty; Vivaswān gave it to Manu, the lawgiver, and Manu to King Ikshvāku.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: यह अविनाशी योग मैंने विवस्वान (सूर्य) को सिखाया था; उन्होंने इसे मनु को बताया, और मनु ने इसे इक्ष्वाकु को सुनाया।

verses.sa:
एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।
स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप
verses.tr:
evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa
wm: with the long passage of time
verses.en: This, handed down in regular succession by the royal sages, was known. This Yoga, however, has been lost here over time, O Parantapa (burner of the foes).
verses.en2: The Divine Kings knew it, for it was their tradition; then, after a long time, it was at last forgotten.
verses.hi: इस प्रकार परम्परा से चला आया यह योग राजर्षियों ने जाना। पर हे परन्तप (शत्रुओं को तपाने वाले), लम्बे समय के साथ यह योग इस संसार में लुप्त हो गया।

verses.sa:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
verses.tr:
sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam
verses.en: That same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me, for you are my devotee and my friend; it is the supreme secret.
verses.en2: It is the same ancient path that I have now revealed to you, for you are my devotee and my friend. It is the supreme secret.
verses.hi: वही पुराना योग आज मैंने तुम्हें बताया है, क्योंकि तुम मेरे भक्त और मित्र हो; यह परम रहस्य है।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।
कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ
katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti
verses.en: Arjuna said, "Later was Thy birth, and prior to it was the birth of Vivasvan (the Sun); how am I to understand that Thou hast taught this Yoga from the beginning?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked: My Lord! Vyasawana was born before You; how then can You have revealed it to him?
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: आपका जन्म तो बाद में हुआ और विवस्वान (सूर्य) का जन्म उससे बहुत पहले हुआ; तो मैं यह कैसे समझूँ कि आपने आरम्भ में यह योग उन्हें सिखाया था?

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।
तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "Many births of Mine have passed, as well as of thine, O Arjuna; I know them all, but thou knowest not, O Parantapa (scorcher of foes)."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have been born again and again, from time to time; thou too, O Arjuna! My births are known to me, but yours are unknown to you.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे अर्जुन, मेरे और तुम्हारे बहुत-से जन्म बीत चुके हैं; हे परन्तप, मैं उन सबको जानता हूँ, पर तुम नहीं जानते।

verses.sa:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।
प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया
verses.tr:
ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san
prakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā
verses.en: Though I am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of all beings, yet, governing my own nature, I am born by my own Maya.
verses.en2: There is no beginning to Me. Though I am imperishable and the Lord of all that exists, I manifest Myself by My own will and power.
verses.hi: यद्यपि मैं अजन्मा और अविनाशी स्वरूप वाला हूँ, और सब प्राणियों का ईश्वर हूँ, फिर भी अपनी प्रकृति को वश में रखकर मैं अपनी माया से जन्म लेता हूँ।

verses.sa:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्
verses.tr:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham
verses.en: Whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness, O Arjuna, then I manifest Myself.
verses.en2: Whenever spirituality decays and materialism is rampant, then, O Arjuna, I reincarnate myself.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जब-जब धर्म का ह्रास होता है और अधर्म बढ़ता है, तब-तब मैं स्वयं को प्रकट करता हूँ।

verses.sa:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे
verses.tr:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām
dharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.en: For the protection of the good, for the destruction of the wicked, and for the establishment of righteousness, I am born in every age.
verses.en2: To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked, and to establish the kingdom of God, I am reborn from age to age.
verses.hi: सज्जनों की रक्षा के लिए, दुष्टों के विनाश के लिए और धर्म की स्थापना के लिए मैं हर युग में जन्म लेता हूँ।

verses.sa:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन
verses.tr:
janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna
verses.en: He who thus knows, in their true light, My divine birth and actions, having abandoned the body, is not born again; he comes to Me, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: He who realizes the divine truth concerning My birth and life does not take birth again; and when he leaves his body, he becomes one with Me.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जो मेरे दिव्य जन्म और कर्मों को इस प्रकार तत्त्व से जान लेता है, वह शरीर छोड़ने के बाद फिर जन्म नहीं लेता; वह मुझे प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः
verses.tr:
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ
bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ
verses.en: Freed from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in Me, taking refuge in Me, purified by the fire of knowledge, many have attained My Being.
verses.en2: Many have merged their existences in Mine, being freed from desire, fear, and anger, always filled with Me and purified by the illuminating flame of self-abnegation.
verses.hi: आसक्ति, भय और क्रोध से मुक्त, मुझमें लीन, मेरी शरण में रहने वाले और ज्ञान की अग्नि से पवित्र हुए बहुत-से लोग मेरे स्वरूप को प्राप्त हो चुके हैं।

verses.sa:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
verses.tr:
ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
verses.en: In whatever way men approach Me, even so do I reward them; My path do men tread in all ways, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: However men try to worship Me, I welcome them. Whatever path they take, it leads to Me in the end.
verses.hi: जो लोग जिस भाव से मेरे पास आते हैं, मैं उन्हें उसी प्रकार फल देता हूँ; हे अर्जुन, मनुष्य हर प्रकार से मेरे ही मार्ग पर चलते हैं।

verses.sa:
काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।
क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा
verses.tr:
kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā
verses.en: Those who long for success in action in this world sacrifice to the gods; for success is quickly attained by men through action.
verses.en2: Those who seek success worship the Powers, and their actions in this world bear immediate fruit.
verses.hi: इस संसार में कर्मों की सफलता चाहने वाले लोग देवताओं की पूजा करते हैं, क्योंकि मनुष्यों को कर्म से सफलता जल्दी मिलती है।

verses.sa:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः।
तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्
verses.tr:
chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ
tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam
verses.en: The fourfold caste has been created by Me according to the differentiation of Guna and Karma; though I am the author of it, know Me as non-doer and immutable.
verses.en2: The four divisions of society—the wise, the soldier, the merchant, and the laborer—were created by Me, according to the natural distribution of qualities and instincts. I am the author of them, though I Myself do not act and am changeless.
verses.hi: गुण और कर्म के भेद के अनुसार चार वर्णों की रचना मैंने की है; उनका कर्ता होते हुए भी मुझे अकर्ता और अविनाशी जानो।

verses.sa:
न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते
verses.tr:
na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā
iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
verses.en: Actions do not taint Me, nor do I have a desire for the fruit of actions. He who knows Me thus is not bound by actions.
verses.en2: My actions do not bind Me, nor do I desire anything that they can bring. He who thus realizes Me is not enslaved by action.
verses.hi: कर्म मुझे लिप्त नहीं करते, और न ही मुझे कर्मों के फल की इच्छा है। जो मुझे इस प्रकार जानता है, वह कर्मों से नहीं बँधता।

verses.sa:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्
verses.tr:
evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam
verses.en: Having known this, the ancient seekers of freedom also performed action; therefore, do thou also perform action, as the ancients did in days of yore.
verses.en2: In the light of wisdom, our ancestors who sought deliverance performed their acts. Act thou also as our fathers of old did.
verses.hi: यह जानकर प्राचीन काल के मुक्ति चाहने वालों ने भी कर्म किए थे; इसलिए तुम भी वैसे ही कर्म करो जैसे पूर्वजों ने पुराने समय में किए थे।

verses.sa:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः।
तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
verses.tr:
kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ
tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
verses.en: What is action? What is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. Therefore, I shall teach you the nature of action and inaction, by knowing which you will be liberated from the evil of Samsara, the wheel of birth and death.
verses.en2: What is action and what is inaction? This is a question that has bewildered the wise. But I will declare to you the philosophy of action, and knowing it, you will be free from evil.
verses.hi: कर्म क्या है और अकर्म क्या है? इस विषय में ज्ञानी भी भ्रमित हो जाते हैं। इसलिए मैं तुम्हें कर्म और अकर्म का स्वरूप बताऊँगा, जिसे जानकर तुम जन्म-मृत्यु के चक्र रूपी संसार के अशुभ से मुक्त हो जाओगे।

verses.sa:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।
अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः
verses.tr:
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ
akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
verses.en: For verily, the true nature of action enjoined by the scriptures should be known, as well as that of forbidden or unlawful action, and of inaction; the nature of action is hard to understand.
verses.en2: It is necessary to consider what is right action, what is wrong action, and what is inaction, for the law of action is mysterious.
verses.hi: शास्त्रों द्वारा बताए गए कर्म का सच्चा स्वरूप जानना चाहिए, निषिद्ध कर्म (विकर्म) का भी और अकर्म का भी; क्योंकि कर्म की गति समझना कठिन है।

verses.sa:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।
स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्
verses.tr:
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ
sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit
verses.en: He who sees inaction in action and action in inaction, he is wise among men; he is a yogi and performer of all actions.
verses.en2: He who can see inaction in action, and action in inaction, is the wisest among men. He is a saint, even though he still acts.
verses.hi: जो कर्म में अकर्म और अकर्म में कर्म देखता है, वही मनुष्यों में बुद्धिमान है; वह योगी है और सब कर्मों को करने वाला है।

verses.sa:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।
ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः
verses.tr:
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ
jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṁ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṁ budhāḥ
verses.en: He whose undertakings are all devoid of desires and selfish purposes, and whose actions have been burned by the fire of knowledge, the wise call him a sage.
verses.en2: The wise call him a sage, for whatever he undertakes is free from the motive of desire, and his deeds are purified by the fire of wisdom.
verses.hi: जिसके सभी कार्य कामना और स्वार्थपूर्ण संकल्प से रहित हैं, और जिसके कर्म ज्ञान की अग्नि में जल चुके हैं, उसे ज्ञानी लोग पण्डित कहते हैं।

verses.sa:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः।
कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः
verses.tr:
tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṁ nitya-tṛipto nirāśhrayaḥ
karmaṇyabhipravṛitto ’pi naiva kiñchit karoti saḥ
wm: attachment to the fruits of action
verses.en: Having abandoned attachment to the fruits of the action, ever content, depending on nothing, he does not do anything even while being engaged in activity.
verses.en2: Having surrendered all claim to the results of his actions, he is always contented and independent; in reality, he does nothing, even though he appears to be acting.
verses.hi: कर्मफल की आसक्ति छोड़कर, सदा संतुष्ट और किसी पर आश्रित न रहने वाला व्यक्ति काम में लगा रहकर भी वास्तव में कुछ नहीं करता।

verses.sa:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः।
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.tr:
nirāśhīr yata-chittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ
śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
verses.en: Without hope, controlling the mind and the self, having abandoned all covetousness, and performing only bodily actions, one incurs no sin.
verses.en2: Expecting nothing, his mind and personality controlled, without greed, doing only bodily actions; though he acts, he remains untainted.
verses.hi: आशा से रहित, मन और इन्द्रियों को वश में रखने वाला, सारे संग्रह का लोभ छोड़ चुका व्यक्ति केवल शरीर से कर्म करते हुए पाप का भागी नहीं होता।

verses.sa:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः।
समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते
verses.tr:
yadṛichchhā-lābha-santuṣhṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate
wm: which comes of its own accord
verses.en: Content with what comes to him without effort, free from the pairs of opposites and envy, even-minded in success and failure, he acts yet is not bound.
verses.en2: Content with what comes to him without any effort of his own, rising above the pairs of opposites, free from envy, his mind balanced in both success and failure; though he acts, the consequences do not bind him.
verses.hi: जो बिना प्रयास के मिल जाए उसी में संतुष्ट, सुख-दुःख जैसे द्वन्द्वों और ईर्ष्या से मुक्त, सफलता और असफलता में समान रहने वाला व्यक्ति कर्म करके भी नहीं बँधता।

verses.sa:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः।
यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते
verses.tr:
gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-chetasaḥ
yajñāyācharataḥ karma samagraṁ pravilīyate
verses.en: To one who is devoid of attachment, who is liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who works for the sake of sacrifice (for the sake of God), the whole action is dissolved.
verses.en2: He who is without attachment, free, his mind centered in wisdom, and his actions done as a sacrifice, leave no trace behind.
verses.hi: जो आसक्ति से रहित है, मुक्त है, जिसका मन ज्ञान में स्थित है और जो यज्ञ के लिए (ईश्वर के लिए) कर्म करता है, उसके सारे कर्म पूरी तरह विलीन हो जाते हैं।

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्।
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना
verses.tr:
brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṁ brahma-karma-samādhinā
verses.en: Brahman is the oblation; Brahman is the melted butter (ghee); by Brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of Brahman; Brahman indeed shall be attained by one who always sees Brahman in action.
verses.en2: For him, the sacrifice is the Spirit; the Spirit and the offering are one; it is the Spirit that is sacrificed in its own fire, and the man, even in action, is united with God, since his mind never ceases to be fixed on Him while performing the act.
verses.hi: अर्पण ब्रह्म है, आहुति का घी ब्रह्म है, ब्रह्म रूपी अग्नि में ब्रह्म द्वारा ही आहुति दी जाती है; जो कर्म में सदा ब्रह्म को देखता है, वह ब्रह्म को ही प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते।
ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति
verses.tr:
daivam evāpare yajñaṁ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṁ yajñenaivopajuhvati
verses.en: Some yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone; while others, who have realized the Self, offer the Self as sacrifice in the fire of Brahman alone.
verses.en2: Some sages sacrifice to the powers, while others offer themselves on the altar of the eternal.
verses.hi: कुछ योगी केवल देवताओं के लिए यज्ञ करते हैं, जबकि आत्मा को जान चुके दूसरे लोग ब्रह्म रूपी अग्नि में आत्मा की ही आहुति देते हैं।

verses.sa:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति।
शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति
verses.tr:
śhrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye sanyamāgniṣhu juhvati
śhabdādīn viṣhayānanya indriyāgniṣhu juhvati
verses.en: Some again offer the organ of hearing and other senses as a sacrifice in the fire of restraint; others offer sound and other objects of the senses as a sacrifice in the fire of the senses.
verses.en2: Some sacrifice their physical senses in the fire of self-control; others offer up their contact with external objects in the sacrificial fire of their senses.
verses.hi: कुछ लोग श्रोत्र आदि इन्द्रियों को संयम रूपी अग्नि में होम करते हैं, और दूसरे लोग शब्द आदि विषयों को इन्द्रिय रूपी अग्नि में होम करते हैं।

verses.sa:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे।
आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते
verses.tr:
sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi chāpare
ātma-sanyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite
wm: in the fire of the controlled mind
verses.en: Others again sacrifice all the functions of the senses and those of the breath (vital energy, or Prana) in the fire of the Yoga of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.
verses.en2: Others again sacrifice their activities and vitality in the spiritual fire of self-abnegation, kindled by wisdom.
verses.hi: कुछ और लोग इन्द्रियों के सब कार्यों और प्राण (जीवन-शक्ति) के कार्यों को ज्ञान से प्रज्वलित आत्म-संयम रूपी योग की अग्नि में होम करते हैं।

verses.sa:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे।
स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः
verses.tr:
dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare
swādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāśh cha yatayaḥ sanśhita-vratāḥ
wm: offering one’s own wealth as sacrifice
performance of eight-fold path of yogic practices as sacrifice
cultivating knowledge by studying the scriptures
those offer cultivation of transcendental knowledge as sacrifice
verses.en: Others again offer wealth, austerity, and Yoga as sacrifice, while ascetics of self-restraint and rigid vows offer the study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice.
verses.en2: Others offer as their sacrifice wealth, austerities, and meditation. Monks, wedded to their vows, renounce their scriptural learning and even their spiritual powers.
verses.hi: कुछ लोग धन, तप और योग को यज्ञ के रूप में अर्पित करते हैं, जबकि संयमी और कठोर व्रत वाले तपस्वी शास्त्रों के अध्ययन और ज्ञान को यज्ञ के रूप में अर्पित करते हैं।

verses.sa:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे।
प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः
verses.tr:
apāne juhvati prāṇaṁ prāṇe ’pānaṁ tathāpare
prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣhu juhvati
sarve ’pyete yajña-vido yajña-kṣhapita-kalmaṣhāḥ
wm: being cleansed by performances of sacrifices
verses.en: Others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming, and the incoming into the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and the incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the restraint of the breath.
verses.en2: There are some who practice controlling the vital energy and governing the subtle forces of prana and apana, thereby sacrificing their prana to apana, or their apana to prana.
verses.hi: कुछ लोग, केवल प्राणायाम में लगे रहकर और प्राण तथा अपान की गति रोककर, अपान में प्राण का और प्राण में अपान का होम करते हैं।

verses.sa:
