अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति।
सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः
verses.tr:
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān  prāṇeṣu juhvati
sarve py 'ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ
wm: conversant   with the purpose of performing
being cleansed of the result of such performances
verses.en: Others who regulate their diet offer life-breaths in each life-breath. All these are knowers of sacrifice, whose sins are destroyed through sacrifice.
verses.en2: Others, controlling their diet, sacrifice their worldly life to the spiritual fire. All understand the principle of sacrifice, and by it their sins are washed away.
verses.hi: कुछ लोग आहार को नियमित रखकर प्राणों को प्राणों में होम करते हैं। ये सभी यज्ञ को जानने वाले हैं, और यज्ञ से इनके पाप नष्ट हो चुके हैं।

verses.sa:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्।
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम
verses.tr:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāmṛita-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṁ loko ’styayajñasya kuto ’nyaḥ kuru-sattama
wm: they partake of the nectarean remnants of sacrifice
for one who performs no sacrifice
verses.en: Those who eat the remnants of the sacrifice, which are like nectar, go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for the one who does not perform sacrifice; how then can they have the other, O Arjuna?
verses.en2: Tasting the nectar of immortality, as the reward of sacrifice, they reach the Eternal. This world is not for those who refuse to sacrifice; nor is the other world.
verses.hi: यज्ञ से बचे अमृत जैसे अन्न को खाने वाले सनातन ब्रह्म को प्राप्त होते हैं। हे अर्जुन, जो यज्ञ नहीं करता उसके लिए यह लोक भी नहीं है, तो परलोक कैसे होगा?

verses.sa:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.tr:
evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase
verses.en: Thus, manifold sacrifices are spread out before Brahman at the face of Brahman. Know them all to be born of action, and thus knowing, you shall be liberated.
verses.en2: In this way, other sacrifices may also be undertaken for the sake of the Spirit. Know that they all depend on action. Knowing this, you will be free.
verses.hi: इस प्रकार अनेक प्रकार के यज्ञ वेद (ब्रह्म) के मुख में फैले हुए हैं। इन सबको कर्म से उत्पन्न जानो; ऐसा जानकर तुम मुक्त हो जाओगे।

verses.sa:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप।
सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते
verses.tr:
śhreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa
sarvaṁ karmākhilaṁ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
verses.en: Superior is wisdom-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects, O Parantapa (scorcher of the foes). All actions in their entirety, O Arjuna, culminate in knowledge.
verses.en2: The sacrifice of wisdom is superior to any material sacrifice, for, O Arjuna, the pinnacle of action is always realization.
verses.hi: हे परन्तप, द्रव्य से होने वाले यज्ञ की अपेक्षा ज्ञान-यज्ञ श्रेष्ठ है। हे अर्जुन, सभी कर्म पूर्ण रूप से ज्ञान में ही समाप्त होते हैं।

verses.sa:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया।
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.tr:
tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśhnena sevayā
upadekṣhyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśhinaḥ
wm: those who have realized the Truth
verses.en: Know that the wise who have realized the truth will instruct thee in that knowledge through long prostration, supplication, and service.
verses.en2: This you shall learn by prostrating yourself at the master's feet, questioning them, and serving them. The wise who have realized the truth will teach you wisdom.
verses.hi: उस ज्ञान को तत्त्व का साक्षात्कार कर चुके ज्ञानियों के पास जाकर, उन्हें प्रणाम करके, विनम्र प्रश्न करके और उनकी सेवा करके सीखो; वे तुम्हें उस ज्ञान का उपदेश देंगे।

verses.sa:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव।
येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि
verses.tr:
yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
yena bhūtānyaśheṣheṇa drakṣhyasyātmanyatho mayi
verses.en: Knowing that thou shalt not, O Arjuna, again be deluded like this; and by that thou shalt see all beings in thyself and also in me.
verses.en2: Having known That, you shall never again be confounded; and, O Arjuna, by the power of that wisdom, you shall see all these people as if they were your own Self, and therefore as Me.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, उसे जानकर तुम फिर इस प्रकार मोह में नहीं पड़ोगे; और उसके द्वारा तुम सब प्राणियों को अपने में और मुझमें भी देखोगे।

verses.sa:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः।
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि
verses.tr:
api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ
sarvaṁ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛijinaṁ santariṣhyasi
wm: by the boat of divine knowledge
verses.en: Even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet thou shalt surely cross over all sins by the raft of knowledge.
verses.en2: Even if you are the greatest of sinners, you will cross over all sin by the ferryboat of wisdom.
verses.hi: यदि तुम सभी पापियों से भी अधिक पापी हो, तब भी ज्ञान रूपी नाव से तुम निश्चय ही सारे पापों को पार कर जाओगे।

verses.sa:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन।
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा
verses.tr:
yathaidhānsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sāt kurute ’rjuna
jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā
verses.en: As the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ash.
verses.en2: As the kindled fire consumes the fuel, so, O Arjuna, the embers of action are burnt to ashes in the flame of wisdom.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जैसे जलती हुई आग ईंधन को राख कर देती है, वैसे ही ज्ञान की अग्नि सारे कर्मों को राख कर देती है।

verses.sa:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति
verses.tr:
na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate
tatsvayaṁ yogasansiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
verses.en: Verily, there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. He who is perfected in Yoga finds it within the Self in due time.
verses.en2: There is nothing in the world so purifying as wisdom; and he who is a perfect saint finds that at last within himself.
verses.hi: इस संसार में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र करने वाला निश्चय ही कुछ नहीं है। जो योग में सिद्ध हो गया है, वह समय आने पर उसे अपने भीतर ही पा लेता है।

verses.sa:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
śhraddhāvān labhate jñānaṁ tat-paraḥ sanyatendriyaḥ
jñānaṁ labdhvā parāṁ śhāntim achireṇādhigachchhati
verses.en: The one who is full of faith, devoted to it, and has subdued their senses obtains this knowledge; and upon obtaining the knowledge, they attain the supreme peace immediately.
verses.en2: He who is full of faith attains wisdom, and he who can control his senses, having attained that wisdom, will soon attain Supreme Peace.
verses.hi: जो श्रद्धा से भरा है, उसी में लगा रहता है और जिसने इन्द्रियों को वश में कर लिया है, वह यह ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है; और ज्ञान पाकर वह तुरन्त परम शान्ति को प्राप्त हो जाता है।

verses.sa:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति।
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः
verses.tr:
ajñaśh chāśhraddadhānaśh cha sanśhayātmā vinaśhyati
nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ
verses.en: The ignorant, the faithless, and the doubting self go to destruction; there is neither this world nor the other, nor happiness for the doubting one.
verses.en2: But the ignorant man, and he who has no faith, and the skeptic are lost. Neither in this world nor elsewhere is there any happiness in store for him who always doubts.
verses.hi: अज्ञानी, श्रद्धाहीन और संशय करने वाला व्यक्ति नष्ट हो जाता है; संशय करने वाले के लिए न यह लोक है, न परलोक, न सुख।

verses.sa:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्।
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
verses.tr:
yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṁ jñāna-sañchhinna-sanśhayam
ātmavantaṁ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
wm: those who renounce ritualistic karm, dedicating their body, mind, and soul to God
situated in knowledge of the self
verses.en: He who has renounced actions through Yoga, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who is self-possessed—such a one is not bound by actions, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: But the one who has renounced their actions for meditation, who has cleaved their doubts in two by the sword of wisdom, and who remains always enthroned in their Self, is not bound by their actions.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जिसने योग द्वारा कर्मों को (ईश्वर को) अर्पित कर दिया है, जिसके संशय ज्ञान से मिट गए हैं और जो आत्मवान है, उसे कर्म नहीं बाँधते।

verses.sa:
तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः।
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत
verses.tr:
tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṁ hṛit-sthaṁ jñānāsinātmanaḥ
chhittvainaṁ sanśhayaṁ yogam ātiṣhṭhottiṣhṭha bhārata
verses.en: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge (of the Self), cut asunder the doubt of the self, born of ignorance, residing in your heart, and take refuge in Yoga. Arise, O Arjuna!
verses.en2: Therefore, cleave asunder with the sword of wisdom the doubts of the heart, which your own ignorance has engendered, and follow the path of wisdom and arise!
verses.hi: इसलिए अज्ञान से उत्पन्न, अपने हृदय में बसे इस संशय को आत्मज्ञान की तलवार से काट डालो, और योग का आश्रय लो। हे अर्जुन, उठो!

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि।
यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi
yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam
verses.en: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, you praise renunciation of actions and also yoga. Please tell me conclusively which is better of the two."
verses.en2: Arjuna said: My Lord! At one moment, You praise renunciation of action; at another, You praise right action. Tell me truly, I pray, which of these is more conducive to my highest welfare?
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे कृष्ण, आप कर्मों के संन्यास की भी प्रशंसा करते हैं और योग की भी। कृपया मुझे निश्चित रूप से बताइए कि इन दोनों में कौन-सा श्रेष्ठ है।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
sannyāsaḥ karma-yogaśh cha niḥśhreyasa-karāvubhau
tayos tu karma-sannyāsāt karma-yogo viśhiṣhyate
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "Renunciation and the Yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss; but of the two, the Yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Both renunciation of action and the path of right action lead to the highest; however, right action is the better of the two.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: कर्म-संन्यास और कर्मयोग दोनों ही परम कल्याण की ओर ले जाते हैं; पर इन दोनों में कर्मयोग कर्म-संन्यास से श्रेष्ठ है।

verses.sa:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.tr:
jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati
nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate
verses.en: He should be known as a perpetual Sannyasi who neither hates nor desires; for, free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed Arjuna, he is easily freed from bondage.
verses.en2: He is a true ascetic who never desires nor dislikes, who is unaffected by the opposites and is easily freed from bondage.
verses.hi: हे महाबाहु अर्जुन, जो न द्वेष करता है और न इच्छा करता है, उसे सदा संन्यासी ही समझना चाहिए; क्योंकि द्वन्द्वों से मुक्त होकर वह सहज ही बन्धन से छूट जाता है।

verses.sa:
सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्
verses.tr:
sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
verses.en: Children, not the wise, speak of knowledge and the Yoga of action, or the performance of action, as though they are distinct and different; he who is truly established in one, obtains the fruits of both.
verses.en2: Only the unenlightened speak of wisdom and right action as separate; the wise do not. If anyone knows one, they enjoy the fruit of both.
verses.hi: ज्ञानी नहीं, बल्कि नासमझ लोग सांख्य (ज्ञान) और कर्मयोग को अलग-अलग बताते हैं; जो इनमें से किसी एक में भी ठीक से स्थित हो जाता है, उसे दोनों का फल मिल जाता है।

verses.sa:
यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते।
एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.tr:
yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate
ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
verses.en: That place which is reached by the Sankhyas or the Jnanis is also reached by the Yogis (Karma Yogis). He who sees knowledge and the performance of action (Karma Yoga) as one, sees truly.
verses.en2: The level which is attained through wisdom is also reached through right action. He who perceives that the two are one, knows the truth.
verses.hi: सांख्य या ज्ञानमार्ग वाले जिस स्थान को पाते हैं, कर्मयोगी भी उसी स्थान को पाते हैं। जो ज्ञान और कर्मयोग को एक ही देखता है, वही सही देखता है।

verses.sa:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ
yoga-yukto munir brahma na chireṇādhigachchhati
wm: one who is adept in karm yog
verses.en: But, O mighty-armed Arjuna, renunciation is hard to attain without Yoga; the sage who is in harmony with Yoga quickly goes to Brahman.
verses.en2: Without concentration, O Mighty One, renunciation is difficult. But the sage who is always meditating on the Divine, shall soon attain the Absolute.
verses.hi: पर हे महाबाहु अर्जुन, योग के बिना संन्यास पाना कठिन है; योग में लगा हुआ मुनि शीघ्र ही ब्रह्म को प्राप्त हो जाता है।

verses.sa:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते
verses.tr:
yoga-yukto viśhuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
sarva-bhūtātma-bhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate
wm: one who has conquered the mind
one who sees the Soul of all souls in every living being
verses.en: He who is devoted to the path of action, whose mind is pure, who has conquered the self, who has subdued his senses, and who realizes his Self as the Self in all beings, though acting, is not tainted.
verses.en2: He who is spiritual, pure, has overcome his senses and his personal self, and has realized his highest Self as the Self of all—even though he acts, he is not bound by his actions.
verses.hi: जो कर्मयोग में लगा है, जिसका मन शुद्ध है, जिसने अपने आप को जीत लिया है, जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ वश में हैं, और जो अपनी आत्मा को सब प्राणियों की आत्मा के रूप में जानता है, वह कर्म करते हुए भी लिप्त नहीं होता।

verses.sa:
नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।
पश्यन् श्रृणवन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपन् श्वसन्
verses.tr:
naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit
paśhyañ śhṛiṇvan spṛiśhañjighrann aśhnangachchhan svapañśhvasan
pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣhu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.en: I do nothing at all," thus would the harmonized knower of Truth think, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, and breathing.
verses.en2: Though the saint sees, hears, touches, smells, eats, moves, sleeps, and breathes, yet he knows the truth and knows that it is not he who acts.
verses.hi: तत्त्व को जानने वाला, योग में स्थित व्यक्ति देखते, सुनते, छूते, सूँघते, खाते, चलते, सोते और साँस लेते हुए भी यही सोचता है कि 'मैं कुछ भी नहीं करता।'

verses.sa:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्
verses.tr: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.en: Speaking, letting go, seizing, opening, and closing the eyes, one should be convinced that the senses move among the sense-objects.
verses.en2: Though he talks, gives, receives, opens his eyes, and shuts them, he still knows that his senses are merely disporting themselves among the objects of perception.
verses.hi: बोलते, छोड़ते, ग्रहण करते, आँखें खोलते और बन्द करते हुए भी वह यह निश्चय रखता है कि इन्द्रियाँ ही अपने विषयों में बरत रही हैं।

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.tr:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā
verses.en: He who does actions, offering them to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water.
verses.en2: He who dedicates his actions to the Spirit, without any personal attachment to them, is no more tainted by sin than the water lily is wetted by water.
verses.hi: जो आसक्ति छोड़कर अपने कर्म ब्रह्म को अर्पित करते हुए करता है, वह पाप से वैसे ही लिप्त नहीं होता जैसे कमल का पत्ता पानी से।

verses.sa:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये
verses.tr:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṁ tyaktvātma-śhuddhaye
verses.en: Yogis, having abandoned attachment, perform actions only through the body, mind, intellect, and even the senses, for the purification of the self.
verses.en2: The sage performs his action dispassionately, using his body, mind, intellect, and even his senses, always as a means for purification.
verses.hi: योगी आसक्ति छोड़कर, अपने अन्तःकरण की शुद्धि के लिए केवल शरीर, मन, बुद्धि और इन्द्रियों से कर्म करते हैं।

verses.sa:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते
verses.tr:
yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm
ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
wm: one who is united in consciousness with God
one who is not united with God in consciousness
verses.en: The one who is united (the well-poised or harmonized) having abandoned the fruit of action attains eternal peace; whereas the one who is not united (the unsteady or unbalanced), impelled by desire and attached to the fruit, is bound.
verses.en2: Having abandoned the fruit of action, he wins eternal peace. Others, unacquainted with spirituality, led by desire and clinging to the benefit they think will follow their actions, become entangled in them.
verses.hi: योग में स्थित व्यक्ति कर्म का फल त्यागकर स्थायी शान्ति पाता है; जबकि जो योग में स्थित नहीं है, वह कामना से प्रेरित होकर फल में आसक्त रहता है और बँध जाता है।

verses.sa:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
verses.tr:
sarva-karmāṇi manasā sannyasyāste sukhaṁ vaśhī
nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan
verses.en: Mentally renouncing all actions and being self-controlled, the embodied one happily rests in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing others (body and senses) to act.
verses.en2: Mentally renouncing all actions, the self-controlled soul enjoys bliss in this body, the city of the nine gates, neither doing anything themselves nor causing anything to be done.
verses.hi: मन से सब कर्मों को त्यागकर और स्वयं को वश में रखकर, देहधारी आत्मा नौ द्वारों वाले नगर (शरीर) में सुख से रहती है; वह न स्वयं कुछ करती है, न दूसरों (शरीर और इन्द्रियों) से कुछ करवाती है।

verses.sa:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते
verses.tr:
na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ
na karma-phala-saṅyogaṁ svabhāvas tu pravartate
verses.en: Neither does the Lord create agency nor actions for the world, nor union with the fruits of actions; rather, it is Nature that acts.
verses.en2: The Lord of this universe has not ordained activity, nor any incentive thereto, nor any relation between an act and its consequences; all this is the work of Nature.
verses.hi: ईश्वर संसार के लिए न कर्तापन रचता है, न कर्म, और न कर्मों के फल से संयोग; यह सब प्रकृति (स्वभाव) ही करती है।

verses.sa:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.tr:
nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛitaṁ jñānaṁ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.en: The Lord takes neither the demerit nor the merit of any; knowledge is enveloped by ignorance, and beings are deluded.
verses.en2: The Lord does not accept responsibility for any person's sin or merit; they are deluded, for wisdom is submerged in ignorance within them.
verses.hi: ईश्वर किसी का न पाप लेता है, न पुण्य; ज्ञान अज्ञान से ढका हुआ है, इसी से प्राणी मोह में पड़ते हैं।

verses.sa:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्
verses.tr:
jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ
teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param
verses.en: But to those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the Self, like the sun, knowledge reveals the Supreme Brahman.
verses.en2: Surely, wisdom is like the sun, revealing the supreme truth to those whose ignorance has been dispelled by the wisdom of the Self.
verses.hi: पर जिनका अज्ञान आत्मज्ञान से नष्ट हो गया है, उनके लिए वह ज्ञान सूर्य की तरह परम ब्रह्म को प्रकाशित कर देता है।

verses.sa:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः
verses.tr:
tad-buddhayas tad-ātmānas tan-niṣhṭhās tat-parāyaṇāḥ
gachchhantyapunar-āvṛittiṁ jñāna-nirdhūta-kalmaṣhāḥ
wm: those whose intellect is directed toward God
those whose heart (mind and intellect) is solely absorbed in God
those whose intellect has firm faith in God
those who strive after God as the supreme goal and refuge
verses.en: Their intellect absorbed in That, their self being That, established in That, with That as their supreme goal, they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by knowledge.
verses.en2: Meditating on the divine, having faith in the divine, concentrating on the divine, and losing themselves in the divine, their sins dissolve in wisdom, and they go from whence there is no return.
verses.hi: जिनकी बुद्धि उसी (ब्रह्म) में लीन है, जिनकी आत्मा वही है, जो उसी में स्थित हैं और जिनका परम लक्ष्य वही है, वे ज्ञान से पापों के मिट जाने पर वहाँ जाते हैं जहाँ से लौटना नहीं होता।

verses.sa:
विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
verses.tr:
vidyā-vinaya-sampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ
verses.en: Sages look with an equal eye on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humility, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and even an outcaste.
verses.en2: Sages look upon all equally, whether they be a minister of learning and humility, an infidel, a cow, an elephant, or a dog.
verses.hi: ज्ञानी लोग विद्या और विनय से सम्पन्न ब्राह्मण, गाय, हाथी, कुत्ते और चाण्डाल को भी समान दृष्टि से देखते हैं।

verses.sa:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
verses.tr:
ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ
nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
verses.en: Even here in this world, those whose minds rest in reality overcome birth; Brahman is indeed spotless and real; therefore they are established in Brahman.
verses.en2: Even in this world, those whose minds remain always balanced, fixed on the Supreme, conquer their earthly life; for the Supreme has neither blemish nor bias.
verses.hi: जिनका मन समता में स्थित है, उन्होंने यहीं इसी लोक में जन्म (संसार) को जीत लिया है; ब्रह्म निर्दोष और सम है, इसलिए वे ब्रह्म में ही स्थित हैं।

verses.sa:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः
verses.tr:
na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam
sthira-buddhir asammūḍho brahma-vid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
wm: having a firm understanding of divine knowledge
verses.en: Resting in Brahman, with a steady intellect and undeluded, the knower of Brahman neither rejoices upon obtaining what is pleasant nor grieves upon obtaining what is unpleasant.
verses.en2: He who knows and lives in the Absolute remains unmoved and unperturbed; he is not elated by pleasure nor depressed by pain.
verses.hi: ब्रह्म में स्थित, स्थिर बुद्धि वाला और मोह से रहित ब्रह्मज्ञानी प्रिय वस्तु पाकर न हर्षित होता है, न अप्रिय पाकर दुःखी होता है।

verses.sa:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते
verses.tr:
bāhya-sparśheṣhvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham
sa brahma-yoga-yuktātmā sukham akṣhayam aśhnute
wm: those who are united with God through yog
verses.en: With the self unattached to external contacts, he finds happiness in the Self; with the self engaged in the meditation of Brahman, he attains endless happiness.
verses.en2: He finds happiness in his own Self and enjoys eternal bliss, whose heart does not yearn for the contacts of the earth and whose Self is one with the Everlasting.
verses.hi: जिसका मन बाहरी विषयों के स्पर्श में आसक्त नहीं है, वह आत्मा में सुख पाता है; ब्रह्म के ध्यान में लगा हुआ वह अनन्त सुख प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
verses.tr:
ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ
wm: born of contact with the sense objects
verses.en: The enjoyments that arise from contact are only sources of pain, for they have a beginning and an end, O Arjuna; the wise do not rejoice in them.
verses.en2: The joys that spring from external associations bring pain; they have their beginnings and their endings. The wise person does not rejoice in them.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, विषयों के संपर्क से उत्पन्न होने वाले भोग दुःख के ही कारण हैं, क्योंकि उनका आदि और अन्त है; ज्ञानी उनमें आनन्द नहीं मानते।

verses.sa:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्।
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
verses.tr:
śhaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṁ prāk śharīra-vimokṣhaṇāt
kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
verses.en: He who is able, while still here in this world, to withstand the impulse born out of desire and anger before the liberation from the body, he is a Yogi, and he is a happy man.
verses.en2: He who, before leaving his body, learns to overcome the promptings of desire and anger, is a saint and is happy.
verses.hi: जो यहीं इस संसार में, शरीर छूटने से पहले, काम और क्रोध से उठने वाले वेग को सह लेने में समर्थ है, वही योगी है और वही सुखी मनुष्य है।

verses.sa:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः।
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
yo 'ntaḥ-sukho 'ntar-ārāmas tathāntar-jyotir eva yaḥ
sa yogī brahma-nirvāṇaṁ brahma-bhūto 'dhigachchhati
verses.en: He who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, that Yogi attains absolute freedom, or Moksha, becoming Brahman himself.
verses.en2: He who is happy within himself and has found its peace, and in whom the inner light shines, that sage attains eternal bliss and becomes one with the spirit.
verses.hi: जो भीतर ही सुखी है, भीतर ही रमता है और जिसके भीतर ही प्रकाश है, वह योगी स्वयं ब्रह्मरूप होकर ब्रह्म-निर्वाण (मोक्ष) को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.tr:
labhante brahma-nirvāṇam ṛiṣhayaḥ kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ
chhinna-dvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
verses.en: The sages obtain absolute freedom or Moksha when their sins have been destroyed, their dualities have been torn asunder, they are self-controlled, and they are intent on the welfare of all beings.
verses.en2: Sages whose sins have been washed away, whose sense of separateness has dissipated, who have subdued themselves, and seek only the welfare of all, come to the Eternal Spirit.
verses.hi: जिनके पाप नष्ट हो गए हैं, जिनके संशय (द्वन्द्व) मिट गए हैं, जो संयमी हैं और सब प्राणियों के हित में लगे रहते हैं, वे ऋषि ब्रह्म-निर्वाण (मोक्ष) प्राप्त करते हैं।

verses.sa:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्
verses.tr:
kāma-krodha-viyuktānāṁ yatīnāṁ yata-chetasām
abhito brahma-nirvāṇaṁ vartate viditātmanām
wm: those self-realized persons who have subdued their mind
verses.en: Absolute freedom exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger, who have controlled their thoughts, and who have realized the Self.
verses.en2: Saints who know themselves, who control their minds, and feel neither desire nor anger, find eternal bliss everywhere.
verses.hi: जो संयमी साधक काम और क्रोध से मुक्त हैं, जिन्होंने अपने विचारों को वश में कर लिया है और आत्मा को जान लिया है, उनके लिए चारों ओर ब्रह्म-निर्वाण ही है।

verses.sa:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ
verses.tr:
sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ
prāṇāpānau samau kṛitvā nāsābhyantara-chāriṇau
yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣha-parāyaṇaḥ
vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
verses.en: Shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, realizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils.
verses.en2: Excluding external objects, with his gaze fixed between the eyebrows, and the inward and outward breathings passing equally through his nostrils;
verses.hi: बाहरी विषयों के सम्पर्क को बाहर ही छोड़कर, दृष्टि को दोनों भौंहों के बीच टिकाकर, नासिका के भीतर चलने वाले प्राण और अपान को सम करके,

verses.sa:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
verses.tr: yatendriya-mano-buddhir  munir   mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā    mukta   eva saḥ
verses.en: With the senses, mind, and intellect ever controlled, having liberation as their supreme goal, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is truly liberated forever.
verses.en2: Governing sense, mind, and intellect, intent on liberation, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is eternally free.
verses.hi: जिसने इन्द्रियों, मन और बुद्धि को वश में कर लिया है, जिसका परम लक्ष्य मोक्ष है, और जो इच्छा, भय और क्रोध से मुक्त है, वह मुनि सदा के लिए मुक्त ही है।

verses.sa:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति
verses.tr:
bhoktāraṁ yajña-tapasāṁ sarva-loka-maheśhvaram
suhṛidaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śhāntim ṛichchhati
verses.en: He who knows Me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and the friend of all beings, attains peace.
verses.en2: Knowing Me as the One who gladly receives all offerings of austerity and sacrifice, as the Mighty Ruler of all the Worlds and the Friend of all beings, he passes to Eternal Peace.
verses.hi: जो मुझे यज्ञों और तपों का भोक्ता, सब लोकों का महान ईश्वर और सब प्राणियों का मित्र जानता है, वह शान्ति प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
anāśhritaḥ karma-phalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ
sa sannyāsī cha yogī cha na niragnir na chākriyaḥ
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said: He who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits of his actions—he is a sannyasi and a yogi, not he who is without fire and without action.
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna said: He who acts out of duty, without considering the consequences, is truly spiritual and a true ascetic; not he who merely observes rituals or shuns all action.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: जो कर्मफल पर आश्रित हुए बिना अपना कर्तव्य कर्म करता है, वही संन्यासी है और वही योगी है; केवल अग्नि (यज्ञ) छोड़ देने वाला या कर्म छोड़ देने वाला नहीं।

verses.sa:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन
verses.tr:
yaṁ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava
na hyasannyasta-saṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaśhchana
verses.en: Do you, O Arjuna, know that Yoga is what they call renunciation; no one indeed becomes a Yogi who has not renounced their thoughts.
verses.en2: O Arjuna, renunciation is indeed what is known as right action. No one can become spiritually enlightened who has not renounced all desires.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जिसे संन्यास कहते हैं, उसी को तुम योग जानो; क्योंकि संकल्पों को त्यागे बिना कोई भी योगी नहीं बनता।

verses.sa:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते
verses.tr:
ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śhamaḥ kāraṇam uchyate
wm: of those who are elevated in Yog
verses.en: For a sage who wishes to attain to Yoga, action is said to be the means; for the same sage who has attained Yoga, inaction is said to be the means.
verses.en2: For the sage who seeks the heights of spiritual meditation, practice is the only method, and when they have attained it, they must maintain themselves there through continual self-control.
verses.hi: जो मुनि योग में आरूढ़ होना चाहता है, उसके लिए कर्म को साधन कहा गया है; और योग में आरूढ़ हो जाने पर उसी मुनि के लिए शान्ति (कर्म से विराम) को साधन कहा गया है।

verses.sa:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते
verses.tr:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣhu na karmasv-anuṣhajjate
sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadochyate
wm: all desires for the fruits of actions
elevated in the science of Yog
verses.en: When a person is not attached to the sense-objects or to actions, having renounced all thoughts, then they are said to have attained Yoga.
verses.en2: When a man renounces even the thought of initiating action, and is not interested in sense objects or any results that may flow from his acts, then he truly understands spirituality.
verses.hi: जब व्यक्ति न इन्द्रियों के विषयों में आसक्त होता है, न कर्मों में, और सारे संकल्पों को त्याग देता है, तब उसे योग में आरूढ़ कहा जाता है।

verses.sa:
उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः
verses.tr:
uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
verses.en: One should raise oneself by one's own self alone; let not one lower oneself; for the self alone is one's own friend, and the self alone is one's own enemy.
verses.en2: Let him seek liberation with the help of his Highest Self, and never disgrace his own Self. For that Self is his only friend; yet it can also be his enemy.
verses.hi: मनुष्य को स्वयं ही अपना उद्धार करना चाहिए, स्वयं को नीचे नहीं गिराना चाहिए; क्योंकि मनुष्य स्वयं ही अपना मित्र है और स्वयं ही अपना शत्रु।

verses.sa:
बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्
verses.tr:
bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat
verses.en: The Self is the friend of the self of him by whom the Self has been conquered; but to the unconquered self, this Self stands in the position of an enemy, like an external foe.
verses.en2: To one who has conquered their lower nature with its help, the Self is a friend; but to one who has not done so, it is an enemy.
verses.hi: जिसने अपने मन को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए उसका मन ही उसका मित्र है; पर जिसने मन को नहीं जीता, उसके लिए वही मन बाहरी शत्रु की तरह शत्रुता करता है।

verses.sa:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः
verses.tr:
jitātmanaḥ praśhāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
wm: one who has conquered one’s mind
verses.en: The Supreme Self of him who is self-controlled and peaceful remains balanced in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honor and dishonor.
verses.en2: The Self of one who is self-controlled and has attained peace is equally unmoved by heat or cold, pleasure or pain, honor or dishonor.
verses.hi: जिसने स्वयं को वश में कर लिया है और जो शान्त है, उसकी परमात्मा में स्थित चेतना सर्दी-गर्मी, सुख-दुःख और मान-अपमान में सम बनी रहती है।

verses.sa:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः
verses.tr:
jñāna-vijñāna-tṛiptātmā kūṭa-stho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityuchyate yogī sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
wm: one who has conquered the senses
one who is in constant communion with the Supreme
verses.en: The Yogi who is satisfied with the knowledge and wisdom of the Self, who has conquered the senses, and to whom a clod of earth, a piece of stone, and gold are all the same, is said to have attained Nirvikalpa Samadhi.
verses.en2: He who desires nothing but wisdom and spiritual insight, who has conquered his senses, and who looks upon a lump of earth, a stone, and fine gold with the same eye, is a real saint.
verses.hi: जो योगी ज्ञान और विज्ञान से तृप्त है, जिसने इन्द्रियों को जीत लिया है, और जिसके लिए मिट्टी का ढेला, पत्थर और सोना समान हैं, उसे योग में स्थित (युक्त) कहा जाता है।

verses.sa:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते
verses.tr:
suhṛin-mitrāryudāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣhya-bandhuṣhu
sādhuṣhvapi cha pāpeṣhu sama-buddhir viśhiṣhyate
verses.en: He who is of the same mind towards the good-hearted, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, the relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous, excels.
verses.en2: He looks impartially on all—lovers, friends, or foes; indifferent, hostile, alien, or relative; virtuous or sinful.
verses.hi: जो हितैषी, मित्र, शत्रु, उदासीन, मध्यस्थ, द्वेष करने वाले, सम्बन्धी, धर्मात्मा और पापी, सबके प्रति समान बुद्धि रखता है, वह श्रेष्ठ है।

verses.sa:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः
verses.tr:
yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yata-chittātmā nirāśhīr aparigrahaḥ
wm: with a controlled mind and body
free from desires for possessions for enjoyment
verses.en: Let the yogi constantly strive to keep the mind steady, remaining in solitude, alone, with the body and mind controlled, and free from hope and greed.
verses.en2: Let the student of spirituality try unceasingly to concentrate his mind; let him live in seclusion, absolutely alone, with his mind and personality controlled, free from desire and without possessions.
verses.hi: योगी को चाहिए कि वह एकान्त में अकेला रहकर, शरीर और मन को वश में रखकर, आशा और संग्रह की इच्छा से मुक्त होकर, निरन्तर मन को स्थिर करने का प्रयास करे।

verses.sa:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्
verses.tr:
śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ
nātyuchchhritaṁ nāti-nīchaṁ chailājina-kuśhottaram
verses.en: In a clean spot, having established a firm seat of his own, neither too high nor too low, made of cloth, skin, and kusha grass layered one over the other.
verses.en2: Having chosen a holy place, let him sit in a firm posture on a seat that is neither too high nor too low, and cover it with a grass mat, a deer skin, and a cloth.
verses.hi: किसी स्वच्छ स्थान पर, जो न बहुत ऊँचा हो न बहुत नीचा, कुशा, मृगछाला और वस्त्र को क्रम से एक के ऊपर एक बिछाकर अपना स्थिर आसन जमाए।

verses.sa:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये
verses.tr:
tatraikāgraṁ manaḥ kṛitvā yata-chittendriya-kriyaḥ
upaviśhyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśhuddhaye
verses.en: There, having made the mind one-pointed, with the actions of the mind and senses controlled, let him, seated on the seat, practice Yoga for the purification of the self.
verses.en2: Seated thus, with his mind concentrated, his functions controlled, and his senses governed, let him practice meditation for the purification of his lower nature.
verses.hi: वहाँ आसन पर बैठकर, मन को एकाग्र करके, मन और इन्द्रियों की क्रियाओं को वश में रखते हुए, अन्तःकरण की शुद्धि के लिए योग का अभ्यास करे।

verses.sa:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।
संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
verses.tr:
samaṁ kāya-śhiro-grīvaṁ dhārayann achalaṁ sthiraḥ
samprekṣhya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśhaśh chānavalokayan
wm: at the tip of the nose
verses.en: Let him firmly hold his body, head, and neck erect and still, gazing at the tip of his nose without looking around.
verses.en2: Let him hold his body, head, and neck erect, motionless and steady; let him look fixedly at the tip of his nose, turning neither to the right nor to the left.
verses.hi: शरीर, सिर और गर्दन को सीधा और अचल रखकर, स्थिर होकर, इधर-उधर न देखते हुए अपनी नासिका के अग्रभाग पर दृष्टि टिकाए।

verses.sa:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
verses.tr:
praśhāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmachāri-vrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ sanyamya mach-chitto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
wm: having me as the supreme goal
verses.en: Serene-minded, fearless, firm in the vow of a Brahmachari, having controlled their mind, thinking of Me and balanced in mind, let them sit, having Me as their supreme goal.
verses.en2: With peace in his heart and no fear, observing the vow of celibacy, with his mind controlled and fixed on Me, let the student lose himself in contemplation of Me.
verses.hi: शान्त मन से, निर्भय होकर, ब्रह्मचर्य के व्रत में दृढ़ रहकर, मन को वश में करके, मुझमें चित्त लगाकर और मुझे ही परम लक्ष्य मानकर संतुलित भाव से बैठे।

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ
śhantiṁ nirvāṇa-paramāṁ mat-sansthām adhigachchhati
wm: keeping the mind absorbed in God
verses.en: Thus, always keeping the mind balanced, the yogi, with the mind controlled, attains the peace abiding in Me, culminating in liberation.
verses.en2: Thus, keeping his mind always in communion with Me and subduing his thoughts, he shall attain that Peace which is Mine and will lead him to liberation at last.
verses.hi: इस प्रकार मन को सदा संतुलित रखते हुए, मन को वश में करने वाला योगी मुझमें स्थित उस शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है जिसकी परिणति मोक्ष में होती है।

verses.sa:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन
verses.tr:
nātyaśhnatastu yogo ’sti na chaikāntam anaśhnataḥ
na chāti-svapna-śhīlasya jāgrato naiva chārjuna
wm: of one who does not sleep enough
verses.en: Verily, Yoga is not possible for him who eats too much, nor for him who does not eat at all, nor for him who sleeps too much, nor for him who is always awake, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Meditation is not for him who eats too much, nor for him who eats not at all; not for him who is overly addicted to sleep, nor for him who is always awake.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, यह योग न बहुत अधिक खाने वाले के लिए सम्भव है, न बिल्कुल न खाने वाले के लिए; न बहुत सोने वाले के लिए, न सदा जागते रहने वाले के लिए।

verses.sa:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा
verses.tr:
yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-cheṣhṭasya karmasu
yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā
verses.en: Yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is moderate in eating and recreation (such as walking, etc.), who exercises moderation in action, and who is moderate in sleep and wakefulness.
verses.en2: But for him who regulates his food and recreation, who is balanced in action, in sleep, and in waking, it shall dispel all unhappiness.
verses.hi: जिसका खाना और घूमना-फिरना संतुलित है, जिसके कर्मों में संयम है, और जिसका सोना और जागना नियमित है, उसके लिए योग दुःखों का नाश करने वाला बन जाता है।

verses.sa:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा
verses.tr:
yadā viniyataṁ chittam ātmanyevāvatiṣhṭhate
niḥspṛihaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadā
verses.en: When the perfectly controlled mind rests in the Self alone, free from longing for any of the objects of desire, then it is said, 'He is united'.
verses.en2: When the mind is completely controlled, centered in the Self, and free from all earthly desires, then the man is truly spiritual.
verses.hi: जब पूरी तरह वश में किया हुआ मन केवल आत्मा में ही स्थित हो जाता है और सब कामनाओं की लालसा से मुक्त हो जाता है, तब कहा जाता है कि वह योग में स्थित (युक्त) है।

verses.sa:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः
verses.tr:
yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā
yogino yata-chittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ
verses.en: As a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker, so is the Yogi of a controlled mind, who practices Yoga in the Self, compared.
verses.en2: The wise man who has conquered his mind and is absorbed in the Self is like a lamp that does not flicker, as it stands sheltered from every wind.
verses.hi: जैसे वायु रहित स्थान में रखा दीपक नहीं काँपता, वैसी ही उपमा उस योगी की दी जाती है जिसका मन वश में है और जो आत्मा में योग का अभ्यास करता है।

verses.sa:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।
यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति
verses.tr:
yatroparamate chittaṁ niruddhaṁ yoga-sevayā
yatra chaivātmanātmānaṁ paśhyann ātmani tuṣhyati
verses.en: When the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, attains quietude, and when one sees the Self by the Self, they are satisfied in their own Self.
verses.en2: There, where the whole of nature is seen in the light of the Self, where the person abides within their Self and is satisfied there, their functions restrained by their union with the Divine, the mind finds rest.
verses.hi: जब योग के अभ्यास से रोका गया मन शान्त हो जाता है, और जब व्यक्ति आत्मा द्वारा आत्मा को देखता है, तब वह अपनी आत्मा में ही संतुष्ट रहता है।

verses.sa:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
verses.tr:
sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam
vetti yatra na chaivāyaṁ sthitaśh chalati tattvataḥ
verses.en: When he (the Yogi) feels that infinite bliss which can be grasped by the pure intellect and which transcends the senses, and is established therein, never moving away from the reality.
verses.en2: When he enjoys the bliss that surpasses the senses and can only be grasped by the pure intellect, when he comes to rest within his highest self, he will never again stray from reality.
verses.hi: जब योगी उस अनन्त आनन्द का अनुभव करता है जो शुद्ध बुद्धि से ग्रहण किया जा सकता है और इन्द्रियों से परे है, और उसमें स्थित होकर वह सत्य से कभी विचलित नहीं होता,

verses.sa:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते
verses.tr:
yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ
yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vichālyate
verses.en: Having obtained it, he thinks there is no other gain superior to it; established in it, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow.
verses.en2: Finding That, he will realize that there is no possession so precious. And once established there, no calamity can disturb him.
verses.hi: जिसे पाकर वह उससे बढ़कर कोई दूसरा लाभ नहीं मानता, और जिसमें स्थित होकर वह भारी दुःख से भी विचलित नहीं होता,

verses.sa:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा
verses.tr:
taṁ vidyād duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogaṁ yogasaṅjñitam
sa niśhchayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviṇṇa-chetasā
wm: state of severance from union with misery
verses.en: Let this be known by the name of Yoga, the severance from union with pain. This Yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undespairing mind.
verses.en2: This inner severance from the affliction of misery is spirituality. It should be practiced with determination and with a heart that refuses to be depressed.
verses.hi: दुःख के संयोग से इस वियोग को ही योग नाम से जानना चाहिए। इस योग का अभ्यास दृढ़ निश्चय के साथ और बिना निराश हुए मन से करना चाहिए।

verses.sa:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः
verses.tr:
saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāns tyaktvā sarvān aśheṣhataḥ
manasaivendriya-grāmaṁ viniyamya samantataḥ
verses.en: Abandoning unreservedly all desires born of Sankalpa (thought and imagination) and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides.
verses.en2: Renouncing every desire that can be imagined, controlling the senses at every point through the power of the mind;
verses.hi: संकल्प (विचार और कल्पना) से उत्पन्न होने वाली सारी कामनाओं को पूरी तरह छोड़कर, और मन के द्वारा सब इन्द्रियों को हर ओर से भली-भाँति रोककर,

verses.sa:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.tr:
śhanaiḥ śhanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛiti-gṛihītayā
ātma-sansthaṁ manaḥ kṛitvā na kiñchid api chintayet
wm: achieved through determination of resolve that is in accordance with scriptures
verses.en: Little by little, let him attain steadiness of the intellect by holding it firmly; having made the mind establish itself in the Self, let him not think of anything else.
verses.en2: Little by little, with the help of his reason controlled by fortitude, let him attain peace; and, fixing his mind on the Self, let him not think of anything else.
verses.hi: धीरे-धीरे धैर्यपूर्वक बुद्धि को दृढ़ता से थामकर उपरति (स्थिरता) प्राप्त करे; मन को आत्मा में स्थित करके कुछ और न सोचे।

verses.sa:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
verses.tr:
yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet
verses.en: From whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, let him restrain it from that and bring it under the control of the Self alone.
verses.en2: When the volatile and wavering mind wanders, let him restrain it and bring it back to its allegiance to the Self.
verses.hi: यह चंचल और अस्थिर मन जिस-जिस कारण से भटककर बाहर जाए, उस-उस से उसे रोककर बार-बार आत्मा के ही वश में लाए।

verses.sa:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्
verses.tr:
praśhānta-manasaṁ hyenaṁ yoginaṁ sukham uttamam
upaiti śhānta-rajasaṁ brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣham
verses.en: Supreme Bliss indeed comes to this Yogi whose mind is made peaceful, whose passion is quelled, who has become Brahman, and who is free from sin.
verses.en2: Supreme bliss is the lot of the sage whose mind attains peace, whose passions subside, who is without sin, and who becomes one with the Absolute.
verses.hi: जिसका मन शान्त हो गया है, जिसका रजोगुण (आवेग) शान्त हो चुका है, जो ब्रह्मरूप हो गया है और पाप से रहित है, उस योगी को निश्चय ही परम आनन्द प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते
verses.tr:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī vigata-kalmaṣhaḥ
sukhena brahma-sansparśham atyantaṁ sukham aśhnute
wm: constantly in touch with the Supreme
verses.en: The yogi, always engaging the mind thus (in the practice of yoga), is freed from sins and easily enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with Brahman (the Eternal).
verses.en2: Thus, free from sin, abiding always in the Eternal, the saint enjoys, without effort, the bliss that flows from the realization of the Infinite.
verses.hi: इस प्रकार मन को सदा योग में लगाने वाला योगी पापों से मुक्त होकर सहज ही ब्रह्म (शाश्वत) के संस्पर्श से मिलने वाले अनन्त आनन्द का अनुभव करता है।

verses.sa:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः
verses.tr:
sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṁ sarva-bhūtāni chātmani
īkṣhate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśhanaḥ
wm: one united in consciousness with God
verses.en: With the mind harmonized by Yoga, he sees the Self abiding in all beings and all beings in the Self; he sees the same everywhere.
verses.en2: He who experiences the unity of life sees his own Self in all beings, and all beings in his own Self, and looks upon everything with an impartial eye.
verses.hi: योग से जिसका मन संतुलित हो गया है, वह आत्मा को सब प्राणियों में और सब प्राणियों को आत्मा में स्थित देखता है; वह सर्वत्र एक समान ही देखता है।

verses.sa:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.tr:
yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati
tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśhyāmi sa cha me na praṇaśhyati
verses.en: He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, never becomes separated from Me, nor do I from him.
verses.en2: He who sees Me in everything and everything in Me, I shall never forsake him, nor shall he lose Me.
verses.hi: जो मुझे सर्वत्र देखता है और सब कुछ मुझमें देखता है, वह मुझसे कभी अलग नहीं होता, और न मैं उससे अलग होता हूँ।

verses.sa:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
verses.tr:
sarva-bhūta-sthitaṁ yo māṁ bhajatyekatvam āsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi sa yogī mayi vartate
verses.en: He who, being established in unity, worships Me, who dwells in all beings, that yogi abides in Me, whatever their mode of living may be.
verses.en2: The sage who realizes the unity of life and who worships Me in all beings, lives in Me, no matter what their lot may be.
verses.hi: जो एकत्व में स्थित होकर सब प्राणियों में बसे हुए मुझे भजता है, वह योगी चाहे किसी भी प्रकार से जीवन बिताए, मुझमें ही रहता है।

verses.sa:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः
verses.tr:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṁ paśhyati yo ’rjuna
sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
verses.en: He who, through the likeness of the Self, O Arjuna, sees reality everywhere, be it pleasure or pain, is regarded as the highest Yogi.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! He is the perfect saint who, having been taught by the likeness within himself, sees the same Self everywhere, regardless of whether the outer form be pleasurable or painful.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जो अपनी आत्मा की समानता से सर्वत्र, सुख में भी और दुःख में भी, एक ही सत्य को देखता है, वह सबसे श्रेष्ठ योगी माना जाता है।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
yo ’yaṁ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṁ na paśhyāmi chañchalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām
wm: Shree Krishna, the killer of the demon named Madhu
verses.en: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, I do not see how this Yoga of equanimity, which you have taught me, can be maintained steadily, due to the restlessness of the mind."
verses.en2: Arjuna said: I do not see how I can attain this state of equanimity which You have revealed, owing to the restlessness of my mind.
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे कृष्ण, आपने जो यह समता का योग बताया है, मन की चंचलता के कारण मुझे इसकी स्थिर अवस्था बनी रहती नहीं दिखती।

verses.sa:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्
verses.tr:
chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham
tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣhkaram
verses.en: The mind is indeed restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding, O Krishna; I consider it as difficult to control as controlling the wind.
verses.en2: My Lord! Verily, the mind is fickle and turbulent, obstinate, and strong; indeed, it is extremely difficult to control, like the wind.
verses.hi: हे कृष्ण, मन वास्तव में चंचल, उथल-पुथल मचाने वाला, बलवान और हठी है; मुझे इसे वश में करना वायु को रोकने जितना कठिन लगता है।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "Undoubtedly, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is difficult to control and restless; but with practice and dispassion, it can be restrained."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Doubtless, O Mighty One, the mind is fickle and exceedingly difficult to restrain; however, O Son of Kunti, with practice and renunciation, it can be done.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे महाबाहु अर्जुन, निःसंदेह मन चंचल है और इसे वश में करना कठिन है; पर अभ्यास और वैराग्य से इसे रोका जा सकता है।

verses.sa:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः
verses.tr:
asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo ’vāptum upāyataḥ
wm: by one whose mind is controlled
verses.en: I think Yoga is hard to be attained by one with an uncontrolled self, but the self-controlled and striving one can attain it by the appropriate means.
verses.en2: It is not possible to attain Self-Realization unless one knows how to control oneself; however, for one who, striving by the proper means, learns such control, it is possible.
verses.hi: मेरा मत है कि जिसका मन वश में नहीं है, उसके लिए योग पाना कठिन है; पर जो संयमी है और प्रयत्न करता है, वह सही उपाय से इसे पा सकता है।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
ayatiḥ śhraddhayopeto yogāch chalita-mānasaḥ
aprāpya yoga-sansiddhiṁ kāṅ gatiṁ kṛiṣhṇa gachchhati
verses.en: Arjuna said, "He who is unable to control himself, even though he has faith, and whose mind wanders away from Yoga, what end does he meet, having failed to attain perfection in Yoga, O Krishna?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked: What of him who fails to control himself, whose mind falls from spiritual contemplation, yet retains his faith and does not attain perfection?
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे कृष्ण, जो श्रद्धा रखते हुए भी स्वयं को वश में नहीं कर पाता और जिसका मन योग से भटक जाता है, वह योग में सिद्धि न पाकर किस गति को प्राप्त होता है?

verses.sa:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि
verses.tr:
kachchin nobhaya-vibhraṣhṭaśh chhinnābhram iva naśhyati
apratiṣhṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
verses.en: Fallen from both, does he not perish like a rent cloud, supportless, O mighty-armed one, deluded on the path of Brahman?
verses.en2: Having failed in both, my Lord, is he without hope, like a riven cloud with no support, lost on the spiritual path?
verses.hi: हे महाबाहु, ब्रह्म के मार्ग में मोहित होकर, बिना सहारे के, दोनों ओर से भ्रष्ट हुआ वह क्या छिन्न-भिन्न बादल की तरह नष्ट नहीं हो जाता?

verses.sa:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते
verses.tr:
etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ
tvad-anyaḥ sanśhayasyāsya chhettā na hyupapadyate
verses.en: O Krishna, please completely dispel this doubt of mine, for it is not possible for anyone but You to do so.
verses.en2: My Lord! You are worthy to solve this doubt once and for all; there is no one else competent to do so, save Yourself.
verses.hi: हे कृष्ण, कृपया मेरे इस संशय को पूरी तरह दूर कीजिए, क्योंकि आपके सिवा कोई दूसरा इसे दूर नहीं कर सकता।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।
नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśhas tasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇa-kṛit kaśhchid durgatiṁ tāta gachchhati
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, neither in this world nor in the next will there be destruction for him; none, indeed, who does good, O my son, ever comes to grief."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved child! There is no destruction for him, either in this world or the next. No evil fate awaits him who treads the path of righteousness.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे अर्जुन, उसका न इस लोक में नाश होता है, न परलोक में; हे तात, भला करने वाला कोई भी कभी दुर्गति को प्राप्त नहीं होता।

verses.sa:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते
verses.tr:
prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ
śhuchīnāṁ śhrīmatāṁ gehe yoga-bhraṣhṭo’bhijāyate
verses.en: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years, he who fell from Yoga is born in a house of the pure and wealthy.
verses.en2: Having reached the worlds where the righteous dwell, and having remained there for many years, he who has strayed from the path of spirituality will be born again into the family of the pure, benevolent, and prosperous.
verses.hi: योग से भटका हुआ व्यक्ति पुण्यात्माओं के लोकों को प्राप्त होकर और वहाँ बहुत वर्षों तक रहकर, पवित्र और समृद्ध लोगों के घर में जन्म लेता है।

verses.sa:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्
verses.tr:
atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etad dhi durlabhataraṁ loke janma yad īdṛiśham
wm: of those endowed with divine wisdom
verses.en: Or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis; verily, such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world.
verses.en2: Or, he may be born in the family of wise sages, though such a birth is indeed very difficult to obtain.
verses.hi: या वह ज्ञानवान योगियों के कुल में ही जन्म लेता है; निश्चय ही ऐसा जन्म इस संसार में बहुत दुर्लभ है।

verses.sa:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
verses.tr:
tatra taṁ buddhi-sanyogaṁ labhate paurva-dehikam
yatate cha tato bhūyaḥ sansiddhau kuru-nandana
verses.en: Then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Then, the experience acquired in his former life will revive, and with it, he will more eagerly strive for perfection than before.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, वहाँ उसे अपने पिछले शरीर में पाया हुआ ज्ञान फिर से मिल जाता है, और वह सिद्धि के लिए पहले से भी अधिक प्रयत्न करता है।

verses.sa:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते
verses.tr:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśho ’pi saḥ
jijñāsur api yogasya śhabda-brahmātivartate
verses.en: By that same former practice, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even he who merely wishes to know Yoga goes beyond the Brahmanic word.
verses.en2: Unconsciously, he will return to the practices of his old life; thus, one who strives to attain spiritual consciousness is certainly superior to one who merely talks about it.
verses.hi: उसी पिछले अभ्यास के बल से वह न चाहते हुए भी योग की ओर खिंचा चला जाता है। योग को केवल जानने की इच्छा रखने वाला भी वेद के कर्मकाण्ड से आगे निकल जाता है।

verses.sa:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.tr:
prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī sanśhuddha-kilbiṣhaḥ
aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
verses.en: But the Yogi who strives assiduously, purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births, reaches the highest goal.
verses.en2: Then, after many lives of earnest striving and absolution of sins, the student of spirituality attains perfection and reaches the Supreme.
verses.hi: पर लगन से प्रयत्न करने वाला योगी पापों से शुद्ध होकर, अनेक जन्मों में धीरे-धीरे सिद्ध होकर परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन
verses.tr:
tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogī
jñānibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaḥ
karmibhyaśh chādhiko yogī
tasmād yogī bhavārjuna
verses.en: The yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics, even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures; he is also superior to men of action; therefore, be thou a yogi, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: The wise person is superior to the ascetic, the scholar, and the man of action; therefore, be thou a wise person, O Arjuna!
verses.hi: योगी तपस्वियों से श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है, शास्त्रों के अध्ययन से ज्ञान पाने वालों से भी श्रेष्ठ है, और कर्मकाण्ड करने वालों से भी श्रेष्ठ है; इसलिए हे अर्जुन, तुम योगी बनो।

verses.sa:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
verses.tr:
yoginām api sarveṣhāṁ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā
śhraddhāvān bhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
verses.en: And among all the Yogis, he who, full of faith and with his inner self merged in Me, worships Me is deemed by Me to be the most devoted.
verses.en2: I look upon him as the best of mystics, who, full of faith, worships Me and abides in Me.
verses.hi: और सब योगियों में भी जो श्रद्धा से भरकर, अपने अन्तर्मन को मुझमें लगाकर मुझे भजता है, उसे मैं सबसे अधिक युक्त (श्रेष्ठ) मानता हूँ।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
verses.tr:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
mayyāsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṁ yuñjan mad-āśhrayaḥ
asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, hear how you shall, without doubt, know Me fully, with your mind intent on Me, practicing Yoga and taking refuge in Me."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna said: Listen, O Arjuna! I will tell you how you can know Me in my full perfection. Practice meditation with your mind devoted to Me and take Me as your refuge.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे अर्जुन, मुझमें मन लगाकर, योग का अभ्यास करते हुए और मेरी शरण लेकर तुम मुझे बिना संदेह के पूरी तरह कैसे जानोगे, वह सुनो।

verses.sa:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते
verses.tr:
jñānaṁ te ’haṁ sa-vijñānam idaṁ vakṣhyāmyaśheṣhataḥ
yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo ’nyaj jñātavyam-avaśhiṣhyate
verses.en: I will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here.
verses.en2: I will reveal this knowledge to you and how it can be realized; once accomplished, there is nothing else worth having in this life.
verses.hi: मैं तुम्हें यह ज्ञान अनुभव (विज्ञान) सहित पूरी तरह बताऊँगा, जिसे जान लेने के बाद यहाँ जानने को और कुछ शेष नहीं रहता।

verses.sa:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.tr:
manuṣhyāṇāṁ sahasreṣhu kaśhchid yatati siddhaye
yatatām api siddhānāṁ kaśhchin māṁ vetti tattvataḥ
wm: of those who have achieved perfection
verses.en: Among thousands of men, one may perchance strive for perfection; even among those successful strivers, only one may perchance know Me in essence.
verses.en2: Among thousands of men, scarcely one strives for perfection, and even among those who gain occult powers, perhaps only one knows me in truth.
verses.hi: हज़ारों मनुष्यों में कोई एक ही शायद सिद्धि के लिए प्रयत्न करता है; और प्रयत्न करने वाले उन सिद्धों में भी कोई एक ही शायद मुझे तत्त्व से जान पाता है।

verses.sa:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा
verses.tr:
bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha
ahankāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛitir aṣhṭadhā
verses.en: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism—thus is My Nature divided eightfold.
verses.en2: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and personality—this is the eightfold division of My manifested nature.
verses.hi: पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश, मन, बुद्धि और अहंकार, इस प्रकार मेरी प्रकृति आठ भागों में बँटी हुई है।

verses.sa:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.tr:
apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām
jīva-bhūtāṁ mahā-bāho yayedaṁ dhāryate jagat
verses.en: O mighty-armed Arjuna, this is the inferior Prakriti; know it as distinct from My higher Prakriti, the very life-element, by which this world is upheld.
verses.en2: This is My inferior nature; however, O valiant one, know that distinct from this is My superior nature, which is the very life that sustains the universe.
verses.hi: हे महाबाहु अर्जुन, यह मेरी अपरा (निचली) प्रकृति है; इससे भिन्न मेरी परा (ऊँची) प्रकृति को जानो, जो जीव रूप है और जिससे यह संसार धारण किया जाता है।

verses.sa:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा
verses.tr:
etad-yonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṁ kṛitsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā
wm: these two (energies) are the source of
verses.en: Know that these two are the womb of all beings; thus, I am the source and dissolution of the whole universe.
verses.en2: It is the womb of all beings; for I am He by Whom the worlds were created and shall be dissolved.
verses.hi: जानो कि ये दोनों प्रकृतियाँ ही सब प्राणियों की उत्पत्ति का स्रोत हैं; इस प्रकार मैं ही सम्पूर्ण जगत का उद्गम और प्रलय हूँ।

verses.sa:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.tr:
mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva
verses.en: There is nothing higher than Me, O Arjuna. All this is strung on Me, like clusters of gems on a string.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! There is nothing higher than Me; all is strung on Me like rows of pearls on a thread.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, मुझसे बढ़कर दूसरा कुछ भी नहीं है। यह सब कुछ मुझमें वैसे ही पिरोया हुआ है जैसे धागे में मणियों के दाने।

verses.sa:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
verses.tr:
raso ’ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śhaśhi-sūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣhu śhabdaḥ khe pauruṣhaṁ nṛiṣhu
wm: of the moon and the sun
verses.en: I am the flavor in water, O Arjuna; I am the light in the moon and the sun; I am the syllable Om in all the Vedas, sound in the ether and virility in men.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! I am the fluidity in water, the light in the sun and moon, the mystic syllable Om in the Vedic scriptures, the sound in ether, and the virility in man.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, मैं जल में रस हूँ, चन्द्रमा और सूर्य में प्रकाश हूँ, सब वेदों में ॐकार हूँ, आकाश में शब्द हूँ और पुरुषों में पुरुषार्थ हूँ।

verses.sa:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु
verses.tr:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu tapaśh chāsmi tapasviṣhu
verses.en: I am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire, the life in all beings, and I am the austerity of ascetics.
verses.en2: I am the fragrance of the earth, the brilliance of fire, the life force in all beings, and the austerity of ascetics.
verses.hi: मैं पृथ्वी में पवित्र सुगन्ध हूँ, अग्नि में तेज हूँ, सब प्राणियों में जीवन हूँ, और तपस्वियों में तप हूँ।

verses.sa:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्
verses.tr:
bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
verses.en: Know Me, O Arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, and the splendour of the splendid objects.
verses.en2: Know, O Arjuna, that I am the eternal seed of being; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, the splendour of the resplendent.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, मुझे सब प्राणियों का सनातन बीज जानो; मैं बुद्धिमानों की बुद्धि हूँ और तेजस्वियों का तेज हूँ।

verses.sa:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ
verses.tr:
balaṁ balavatāṁ chāhaṁ kāma-rāga-vivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣhu kāmo ’smi bharatarṣhabha
wm: Arjun, the best of the Bharats
verses.en: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment, and in all beings, I am the desire in accordance with Dharma, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: I am the strength of the strong, those who are free from attachment and desire; and, O Arjuna, I am the desire for righteousness.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, बलवानों में मैं कामना और आसक्ति से रहित बल हूँ, और सब प्राणियों में धर्म के अनुकूल काम (इच्छा) हूँ।

verses.sa:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि
verses.tr:
ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣhu te mayi
verses.en: Whatever beings (and objects) that are pure, active, and inert, know that they proceed from Me. They are in Me, yet I am not in them.
verses.en2: Whatever be the nature of their life, whether it be pure, passionate, or ignorant, they are all derived from Me. They are in Me, but I am not in them.
verses.hi: जो भी सात्त्विक, राजसिक और तामसिक भाव (प्राणी और पदार्थ) हैं, उन्हें मुझसे ही उत्पन्न जानो। वे मुझमें हैं, पर मैं उनमें नहीं हूँ।

verses.sa:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्
verses.tr:
tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat
mohitaṁ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ param avyayam
wm: consisting of the modes of material nature
verses.en: Deluded by these Natures, composed of the three qualities of Nature, all this world does not know Me as distinct from them and immutable.
verses.en2: The inhabitants of the world, misled by the natures engendered by the Qualities, do not know that I am higher than them all and that I do not change.
verses.hi: प्रकृति के तीन गुणों से बने इन भावों से मोहित होकर यह सारा जगत मुझे नहीं जानता, जो इनसे परे और अविनाशी हूँ।

verses.sa:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
verses.tr:
daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te
wm: consisting of the three modes of nature
one of God’s energies. It that veils God’s true nature from souls who have not yet attained the eligibility for God-realization
verses.en: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, composed of the three qualities, is difficult to cross over; those who take refuge in Me alone, can cross over this illusion.
verses.en2: Verily, this divine illusion of phenomenon manifesting itself in the qualities is difficult to surmount. Only they who devote themselves exclusively to Me can accomplish it.
verses.hi: मेरी यह त्रिगुणमयी दिव्य माया निश्चय ही पार करने में कठिन है; जो केवल मेरी शरण लेते हैं, वे ही इस माया को पार कर पाते हैं।

verses.sa:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः
verses.tr:
na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛita-jñānā āsuraṁ bhāvam āśhritāḥ
wm: one who lazily follows one’s lower nature
verses.en: The evil-doers and the deluded, who are the lowest of men, do not seek Me; those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons.
verses.en2: The sinner, the ignorant, the vile, deprived of spiritual perception by the glamour of illusion, and he who leads a godless life—none of them shall find me.
verses.hi: बुरे कर्म करने वाले, मूढ़ और मनुष्यों में अधम लोग मुझे नहीं खोजते; माया से जिनका ज्ञान छिन गया है, वे आसुरी स्वभाव का आश्रय लेते हैं।

verses.sa:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ
verses.tr:
chatur-vidhā bhajante māṁ janāḥ sukṛitino ’rjuna
ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha
wm: those who are situated in knowledge
The best amongst the Bharatas, Arjun
verses.en: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna, and they are the distressed, the seekers of knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the wise, O Lord of the Bharatas.
verses.en2: O Arjuna! The righteous who worship Me are grouped in stages: first, those who suffer, next those who desire knowledge, then those who thirst after truth, and lastly those who attain wisdom.
verses.hi: हे भरतश्रेष्ठ अर्जुन, चार प्रकार के पुण्यात्मा लोग मुझे भजते हैं: दुःखी, ज्ञान चाहने वाले, धन चाहने वाले और ज्ञानी।

verses.sa:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
verses.tr:
teṣhāṁ jñānī nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viśhiṣhyate
priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ
wm: those who are situated in knowledge
verses.en: Of them, the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the One, excel; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to Me.
verses.en2: Of all these, he who has gained wisdom, who meditates on Me without ceasing, devoting himself solely to Me, is the best; for I am exceedingly beloved by the wise man, and the wise man is also beloved by Me.
verses.hi: उनमें सदा मुझमें स्थित और एक में ही भक्ति रखने वाला ज्ञानी श्रेष्ठ है; क्योंकि ज्ञानी को मैं अत्यन्त प्रिय हूँ और वह मुझे प्रिय है।

verses.sa:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
verses.tr:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim
verses.en: Indeed, all these are noble; however, I consider the wise man as My very Self; for, he is steadfast in mind and established in Me alone as the supreme goal.
verses.en2: Noble-minded are they all, but the wise man I hold as my own self; for he, remaining always at peace with me, makes me his ultimate goal.
verses.hi: निश्चय ही ये सभी उदार (श्रेष्ठ) हैं; पर ज्ञानी को मैं अपना ही स्वरूप मानता हूँ; क्योंकि उसका मन स्थिर है और वह मुझे ही परम लक्ष्य मानकर मुझमें स्थित है।

verses.sa:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः
verses.tr:
bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ
wm: one who is endowed with knowledge
Shree Krishna, the son of Vasudev
verses.en: At the end of many births, the wise man comes to Me, realizing that all this is Vaasudeva (the innermost Self); such a great soul (Mahatma) is very hard to find.
verses.en2: After many lives, at last the wise one realizes Me as I am. It is very difficult to find a man so enlightened that he sees God everywhere.
verses.hi: बहुत जन्मों के अन्त में ज्ञानी यह जानकर मेरी शरण आता है कि सब कुछ वासुदेव (सबकी अन्तरात्मा) ही है; ऐसा महात्मा बहुत दुर्लभ है।

verses.sa:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
verses.tr:
kāmais tais tair hṛita-jñānāḥ prapadyante ’nya-devatāḥ
taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā
wm: whose knowledge has been carried away
verses.en: Those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire, go to other gods, following this or that rite, led by their own nature.
verses.en2: They in whom wisdom is obscured by one desire or another, worship the lesser powers, practicing many rites that vary according to their temperaments.
verses.hi: जिनका ज्ञान तरह-तरह की कामनाओं ने हर लिया है, वे अपने स्वभाव से प्रेरित होकर, तरह-तरह के नियमों का पालन करते हुए दूसरे देवताओं की शरण लेते हैं।

verses.sa:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्
verses.tr:
yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham
verses.en: Whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith, I make that same faith of his firm and unflinching.
verses.en2: But whatever form of worship, if the devotee has faith, then I set My own seal upon their faith in that worship.
verses.hi: जो-जो भक्त जिस-जिस रूप को श्रद्धा से पूजना चाहता है, मैं उसकी उसी श्रद्धा को दृढ़ और अटल कर देता हूँ।

verses.sa:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
verses.tr:
sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān
verses.en: Endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome, which is ordained by Me alone.
verses.en2: If he worships one form alone with real faith, then his desires shall be fulfilled through that alone; for thus I have ordained.
verses.hi: उस श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर वह उस रूप की उपासना करता है और अपना इच्छित फल पाता है, जो वास्तव में मेरे द्वारा ही दिया जाता है।

verses.sa:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि
verses.tr:
antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api
wm: the worshipers of the celestial gods
verses.en: Verily, the reward (fruit) that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. The worshippers of the gods go to them, whereas My devotees come to Me.
verses.en2: The fruit that comes to people of limited insight is, after all, finite. Those who worship the Lower Powers attain them; but those who worship Me come to Me alone.
verses.hi: पर उन कम समझ वाले लोगों को मिलने वाला फल नाशवान होता है। देवताओं को पूजने वाले देवताओं को प्राप्त होते हैं, जबकि मेरे भक्त मुझे प्राप्त होते हैं।

verses.sa:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्
verses.tr:
avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam
verses.en: The foolish think of Me, the Unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing My higher, immutable, and most excellent nature.
verses.en2: The ignorant think of Me, who am the Unmanifested Spirit, as if I were in human form. They do not understand that My Superior Nature is unchanging and most excellent.
verses.hi: मूर्ख लोग मेरे ऊँचे, अविनाशी और सर्वश्रेष्ठ स्वरूप को न जानकर मुझ अव्यक्त को व्यक्ति रूप में आया हुआ मानते हैं।

verses.sa:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
verses.tr:
nāhaṁ prakāśhaḥ sarvasya yoga-māyā-samāvṛitaḥ
mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam
verses.en: I am not manifest to all, veiled as I am by the Yoga-Maya. This deluded world does not know Me, who am unborn and imperishable.
verses.en2: I am not visible to all, for I am enveloped by the illusion of the Phenomenon. This deluded world does not know Me as the Unborn and Imperishable.
verses.hi: योगमाया से ढका हुआ मैं सबके सामने प्रकट नहीं होता। यह मोहित संसार मुझ अजन्मा और अविनाशी को नहीं जानता।

verses.sa:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
verses.tr:
vedāhaṁ samatītāni vartamānāni chārjuna
bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana
verses.en: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the past, the present, and the future; however, no one knows Me.
verses.en2: I know, O Arjuna, all beings in the past, the present, and the future; but they do not know Me.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, मैं भूतकाल, वर्तमान और भविष्य के सब प्राणियों को जानता हूँ; पर मुझे कोई नहीं जानता।

verses.sa:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।
सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप
verses.tr:
ichchhā-dveṣha-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhārata
