verses.en: Now, O Arjuna, Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; then Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and then Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.
verses.en2: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, कभी रजस और तमस को दबाकर सत्त्व प्रबल होता है; कभी सत्त्व और तमस को दबाकर रजस; और कभी सत्त्व और रजस को दबाकर तमस।

verses.sa: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
verses.tr:
sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate
jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta
verses.en: When the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.
verses.en2: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.
verses.hi: जब इस शरीर के सब द्वारों में ज्ञान का प्रकाश चमकने लगे, तब जानना चाहिए कि सत्त्व प्रबल है।

verses.sa: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
verses.tr:
lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā
rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha
wm: the best of the Bharatas, Arjun
verses.en: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जब रजस प्रबल होता है, तब लोभ, सक्रियता, कर्मों का आरम्भ, अशान्ति और लालसा उत्पन्न होते हैं।

verses.sa: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
verses.tr:
aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha
tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana
wm: the joy of the Kurus, Arjun
verses.en: Darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Darkness, stagnation, folly, and infatuation are the results of the dominance of ignorance, O joy of the Kuru clan!
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जब तमस प्रबल होता है, तब अन्धकार, जड़ता, असावधानी और मोह उत्पन्न होते हैं।

verses.sa: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
verses.tr:
yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit
tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate
verses.en: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest.
verses.en2: When purity prevails, the soul, upon leaving the body, passes on to the pure regions where those who know the Highest reside.
verses.hi: यदि सत्त्व के प्रबल रहते देहधारी की मृत्यु होती है, तो वह परम तत्व को जानने वालों के निर्मल लोकों को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
verses.tr:
rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣhu jāyate
tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate
verses.en: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.
verses.en2: When passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.
verses.hi: रजस में मृत्यु होने पर वह कर्म में आसक्त लोगों के बीच जन्म लेता है; और तमस में मरने पर वह विवेकहीन योनियों में जन्म लेता है।

verses.sa: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
verses.tr:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam
rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.en: They say that the fruit of good action is Sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.
verses.en2: They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and pure; the outcome of passion is misery, and of ignorance, darkness.
verses.hi: कहते हैं कि अच्छे कर्म का फल सात्त्विक और निर्मल होता है; रजस का फल दुख है, और तमस का फल अज्ञान है।

verses.sa: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
verses.tr:
sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha
pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato ’jñānam eva cha
verses.en: From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.
verses.en2: Purity engenders wisdom, passion avarice, and ignorance folly, infatuation, and darkness.
verses.hi: सत्त्व से ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है और रजस से लोभ; तमस से असावधानी, मोह और अज्ञान भी उत्पन्न होते हैं।

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
verses.tr:
ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanya-guṇa-vṛitti-sthā adho gachchhanti tāmasāḥ
wm: those situated in the mode of goodness
those in the mode of passion
those in the mode of ignorance
verses.en: Those seated in Sattva ascend; those of Rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of Tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, descend.
verses.en2: When purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when passion is in the ascendant, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when ignorance is in the ascendant, he is lost.
verses.hi: सत्त्व में स्थित लोग ऊपर उठते हैं; राजसी स्वभाव वाले बीच में रहते हैं; और सबसे निचले गुण की वृत्ति में रहने वाले तामसी लोग नीचे गिरते हैं।

verses.sa: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
verses.tr:
nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣhṭānupaśhyati
guṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati
verses.en: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to My Being.
verses.en2: As soon as one understands that it is only the qualities that act and nothing else, and perceives that which is beyond, they attain My divine nature.
verses.hi: जब द्रष्टा गुणों के अतिरिक्त किसी और को कर्ता नहीं देखता और गुणों से परे तत्व को जान लेता है, तब वह मेरे स्वरूप को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
verses.tr:
guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān
janma-mṛityu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto ’mṛitam aśhnute
wm: the three modes of material nature
verses.en: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality.
verses.en2: When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he drinks the nectar of immortality.
verses.hi: जिन तीन गुणों से शरीर बना है, उन्हें पार करके देहधारी जन्म, मृत्यु, बुढ़ापे और दुख से मुक्त हो जाता है और अमरत्व प्राप्त करता है।

verses.sa: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho
kim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate
verses.en: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, O Lord? What is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, how can one recognize someone who has transcended the qualities? How do they act and live beyond them?"
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे प्रभु, जो तीनों गुणों से परे हो गया है, उसके लक्षण क्या हैं? उसका आचरण कैसा होता है, और वह इन तीन गुणों को कैसे पार करता है?

verses.sa: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
verses.tr:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
prakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava
na dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "When light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent.
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who does not shun the quality that is present and does not long for that which is absent;
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: जब प्रकाश, सक्रियता और मोह उपस्थित होते हैं, तो वह उनसे द्वेष नहीं करता, और जब वे नहीं होते, तो उनकी इच्छा नहीं करता।

verses.sa: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
verses.tr:
udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate
guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate
wm: to the modes of material nature
verses.en: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move.
verses.en2: He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the qualities, who realizes that it is only they who act, and remains calm;
verses.hi: जो उदासीन की तरह स्थित रहकर गुणों से विचलित नहीं होता, और यह जानकर कि गुण ही अपना काम कर रहे हैं, अपने में स्थिर रहता है और डगमगाता नहीं,

verses.sa: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः
verses.tr:
sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-sanstutiḥ
verses.en: Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm, and to whom censure and praise are one and the same.
verses.en2: Who accepts pain and pleasure as they come, is centered in their Self, to whom a piece of clay, stone, or gold are all the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;
verses.hi: जो सुख और दुख में समान है, आत्मा में स्थित है, जिसके लिए मिट्टी का ढेला, पत्थर और सोना एक समान हैं, जो प्रिय और अप्रिय के प्रति समान है, जो धीर है, और जिसके लिए निन्दा और स्तुति एक ही हैं,

verses.sa: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते
verses.tr:
mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣhayoḥ
sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa uchyate
wm: risen above the three modes of material nature
verses.en: Who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities.
verses.en2: Who looks equally upon honor and dishonor, loves friends and foes alike, and abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the qualities.
verses.hi: जो मान और अपमान में समान है, मित्र और शत्रु के प्रति समान है, और जिसने सब उपक्रमों का त्याग कर दिया है, वह गुणों से परे कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.tr:
māṁ cha yo ’vyabhichāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate
sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
wm: the three modes of material nature
verses.en: And he who serves Me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming Brahman.
verses.en2: And he who serves Me alone, with unwavering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities and become one with the Eternal.
verses.hi: और जो अटल भक्तियोग से मेरी सेवा करता है, वह इन गुणों को पार करके ब्रह्म बनने के योग्य हो जाता है।

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
verses.tr:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣhṭhāham amṛitasyāvyayasya cha
śhāśhvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya cha
verses.en: For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting Dharma, and absolute bliss.
verses.en2: For I am the home of the spirit, the continual source of immortality, eternal righteousness, and infinite joy.
verses.hi: क्योंकि मैं ही ब्रह्म का आधार हूँ, अमर और अविनाशी का, शाश्वत धर्म का और परम आनन्द का।

verses.sa: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.tr:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śhākham aśhvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam
chhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said: They (the wise) speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it is a knower of the Vedas.
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna continued: This phenomenal creation, which is both ephemeral and eternal, is like a tree, with its seed above in the Highest and its ramifications below on this earth. The scriptures are its leaves, and he who understands this knows.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: ज्ञानी एक अविनाशी पीपल के वृक्ष की बात करते हैं, जिसकी जड़ें ऊपर और शाखाएँ नीचे हैं, और जिसके पत्ते वेद के छन्द या मन्त्र हैं; जो इसे जानता है, वही वेदों को जानने वाला है।

verses.sa: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि     कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके
verses.tr:
adhaśh chordhvaṁ prasṛitās tasya śhākhā
guṇa-pravṛiddhā viṣhaya-pravālāḥ
adhaśh cha mūlāny anusantatāni
karmānubandhīni manuṣhya-loke
verses.en: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the Gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action.
verses.en2: Its branches shoot upwards and downwards, deriving their nourishment from the qualities; its buds are the objects of sense; and its roots, which follow the law, causing man's regeneration and degeneration, pierce downwards into the soil.
verses.hi: गुणों से पोषित होकर इसकी शाखाएँ नीचे और ऊपर फैली हैं; इन्द्रियों के विषय इसकी कोंपलें हैं, और कर्म को जन्म देने वाली इसकी जड़ें नीचे मनुष्यलोक में फैली हुई हैं।

verses.sa: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल    मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा
verses.tr:
na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate
nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā
aśhvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam
asaṅga-śhastreṇa dṛiḍhena chhittvā
verses.en: Its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.
verses.en2: In this world, its true form is not known, neither its origin nor its end, and its strength is not understood—until the tree, with its roots striking deep into the earth, is hewn down by the sharp axe of non-attachment.
verses.hi: इसका वास्तविक रूप यहाँ दिखाई नहीं देता, न इसका अन्त, न आरम्भ, न आधार, न ठिकाना; इस गहरी जड़ों वाले पीपल के वृक्ष को अनासक्ति की दृढ़ कुल्हाड़ी से काटकर,

verses.sa: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी
verses.tr:
tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ
yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tam eva chādyaṁ puruṣhaṁ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī
verses.en: Then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. I seek refuge in that Primeval Purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.
verses.en2: Beyond lies the path, from which, once found, there is no return. This is the Primal God from whom this ancient creation has sprung.
verses.hi: फिर उस लक्ष्य को खोजना चाहिए, जहाँ पहुँचकर कोई फिर नहीं लौटता। मैं उस आदि पुरुष की शरण लेता हूँ, जिससे यह पुरातन प्रवृत्ति या शक्ति प्रवाहित हुई है।

verses.sa: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्
verses.tr:
nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā
adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ
dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair
gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat
wm: dwelling constantly in the self and God
verses.en: Free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they, the undeluded, reach the eternal goal.
verses.en2: The wise attain Eternity when, freed from pride and delusion, they have conquered their love for the things of sense; when, renouncing desire and fixing their gaze on the Self, they cease to be tossed to and fro by the opposing sensations, such as pleasure and pain.
verses.hi: जो मान और मोह से मुक्त हैं, जिन्होंने आसक्ति के दोष को जीत लिया है, जो सदा आत्मा में स्थित हैं, जिनकी कामनाएँ पूरी तरह शान्त हो गई हैं, और जो सुख-दुख नामक द्वन्द्वों से मुक्त हैं, वे मोहरहित लोग उस शाश्वत पद को प्राप्त होते हैं।

verses.sa: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.tr:
na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
verses.en: Neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is My supreme abode.
verses.en2: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor fire shines there. Those who go there never come back. For, O Arjuna, that is my celestial home!
verses.hi: वहाँ न सूर्य प्रकाश करता है, न चन्द्रमा, न अग्नि; वहाँ जाकर कोई लौटता नहीं; वही मेरा परम धाम है।

verses.sa: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति
verses.tr:
mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati
verses.en: An eternal portion of Myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in Nature.
verses.en2: It is only a very small part of My Eternal Self, which is the life of the universe, that draws around itself the six senses, with the mind being the last, which have their source in Nature.
verses.hi: मेरा ही एक सनातन अंश जीवलोक में जीवात्मा बनकर प्रकृति में स्थित पाँच इन्द्रियों और छठे मन को अपनी ओर खींचता है।

verses.sa: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्
verses.tr:
śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ
gṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt
wm: the Lord of the material body, the embodied soul
verses.en: When the Lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when He leaves it, He takes these with Him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats (flowers, etc.).
verses.en2: When the Supreme Lord enters a body or leaves it, He gathers these senses together and travels with them, as the wind gathers perfume while passing through the flowers.
verses.hi: जब ईश्वर जीवात्मा के रूप में शरीर प्राप्त करता है और जब उसे छोड़ता है, तब वह इन्हें अपने साथ ले जाता है, जैसे वायु फूलों आदि से सुगन्ध को ले जाती है।

verses.sa: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते
verses.tr:
śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha
adhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate
verses.en: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses.
verses.en2: He is the perception of the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste, the smell, and the mind; and the enjoyment of the things they perceive is also His.
verses.hi: कान, आँख, त्वचा, जीभ, नाक और मन का आश्रय लेकर वह इन्द्रियों के विषयों का भोग करता है।

verses.sa: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
verses.tr:
utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ
wm: under the spell of the modes of material nature
those who possess the eyes of knowledge
verses.en: The deluded do not see Him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold Him.
verses.en2: The ignorant do not see that it is He who is present in life and departs at death, or even that it is He who enjoys pleasure through the qualities. Only the eye of wisdom sees this.
verses.hi: शरीर छोड़ते हुए, उसमें रहते हुए या भोग करते हुए उसे मूढ़ लोग नहीं देखते; परन्तु जिनके पास ज्ञान के नेत्र हैं, वे उसे देखते हैं।

verses.sa: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः
verses.tr:
yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam
yatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ
wm: those whose minds are not purified
verses.en: The yogis striving for perfection behold Him dwelling in the Self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see Him.
verses.en2: The saints, with great effort, find Him within themselves; however, the unintelligent, despite their efforts, cannot control their minds.
verses.hi: सिद्धि के लिए प्रयत्न करने वाले योगी उसे अपने भीतर स्थित देखते हैं; परन्तु जिनका अन्तःकरण शुद्ध नहीं है और जो विवेकहीन हैं, वे प्रयत्न करते हुए भी उसे नहीं देखते।

verses.sa: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्
verses.tr:
yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam
yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam
verses.en: That light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be Mine.
verses.en2: Remember that the light which proceeds from the sun, illuminating the whole world, and the light which is in the moon, and that which is in the fire, all are born of me.
verses.hi: जो प्रकाश सूर्य में स्थित होकर सारे संसार को प्रकाशित करता है, और जो चन्द्रमा तथा अग्नि में है, उस प्रकाश को मेरा ही जानो।

verses.sa: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
verses.tr:
gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā
puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
verses.en: Permeating the earth, I support all beings with My energy; and having become the watery moon, I nourish all herbs.
verses.en2: I enter this world and animate all My creatures with My vitality; and by My cool moonbeams, I nourish the plants.
verses.hi: मैं पृथ्वी में प्रवेश करके अपनी शक्ति से सब प्राणियों को धारण करता हूँ; और रसमय चन्द्रमा बनकर सब वनस्पतियों का पोषण करता हूँ।

verses.sa: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्
verses.tr:
ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ
prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham
verses.en: Having become the fire Vaisvanara, I abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the Prana and the Apana, digest the fourfold food.
verses.en2: Becoming the fire of life, I pass into their bodies and, uniting with the vital streams of Prāṇa and Apāna, I digest the various kinds of food.
verses.hi: मैं वैश्वानर अग्नि बनकर प्राणियों के शरीर में रहता हूँ, और प्राण तथा अपान से युक्त होकर चार प्रकार के अन्न को पचाता हूँ।

verses.sa: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्
verses.tr:
sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo
mattaḥ smṛitir jñānam apohanaṁ cha
vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo
vedānta-kṛid veda-vid eva chāham
wm: the knower of the meaning of the Vedas
verses.en: And I am seated in the hearts of all; from Me come memory and knowledge, as well as their absence. I am verily That which has to be known by all the Vedas; I am indeed the author of the Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.
verses.en2: I am enthroned in the hearts of all; memory, wisdom, and discrimination owe their origins to Me. I am He Who is to be realized in the scriptures; I inspire their wisdom, and I know their truth.
verses.hi: और मैं सबके हृदय में स्थित हूँ; मुझसे ही स्मृति और ज्ञान आते हैं, और उनका लोप भी। सब वेदों के द्वारा जानने योग्य मैं ही हूँ; वेदान्त का रचयिता और वेदों का ज्ञाता भी मैं ही हूँ।

verses.sa: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते
verses.tr:
dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha
kṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate
verses.en: Two Purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable, and the Kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable.
verses.en2: There are two aspects in Nature: the perishable and the imperishable. All life in this world belongs to the former, while the unchanging element belongs to the latter.
verses.hi: इस संसार में दो पुरुष हैं: नश्वर और अविनाशी। सब प्राणी नश्वर हैं, और कूटस्थ, जो अपरिवर्तनशील है, अविनाशी कहलाता है।

verses.sa: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः
verses.tr:
uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ
yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ
verses.en: But distinct is the Supreme Purusha, called the highest Self, indestructible and Lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.
verses.en2: But I am higher than all, the Supreme God, the Absolute Self, the Eternal Lord, who pervades and upholds all the worlds.
verses.hi: परन्तु इनसे भिन्न एक परम पुरुष है, जिसे परमात्मा कहा जाता है; वह अविनाशी ईश्वर तीनों लोकों में प्रवेश करके उनका पालन करता है।

verses.sa: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.tr:
yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ
ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ
verses.en: As I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am declared to be the highest Purusha in the world and in the Vedas.
verses.en2: I am beyond comparison with the Eternal and the non-eternal; I am known as the Supreme Personality, the Highest God, by scriptures and sages.
verses.hi: क्योंकि मैं नश्वर से परे हूँ और अविनाशी से भी उत्तम हूँ, इसलिए संसार में और वेदों में मैं पुरुषोत्तम के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हूँ।

verses.sa: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत
verses.tr:
yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam
sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata
verses.en: He who, undeluded, knows Me as the highest Purusha, he, knowing all, worships Me with his whole being (heart), O Arjuna.
verses.en2: He who, with unclouded vision, sees Me as the Lord-God, knows all that there is to be known and will always worship Me with his whole heart.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जो मोहरहित होकर मुझे पुरुषोत्तम के रूप में जानता है, वह सब कुछ जानने वाला होकर पूरे हृदय से मेरी उपासना करता है।

verses.sa: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत
verses.tr:
iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha
etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata
wm: who fulfills all that is to be accomplished
verses.en: Thus, I have imparted to you this most secret science, O sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Thus, O sinless one, I have revealed this most mystic knowledge to thee. He who understands it gains wisdom and attains the consummation of life.
verses.hi: हे निष्पाप अर्जुन, इस प्रकार मैंने तुम्हें यह अत्यन्त गुप्त शास्त्र बताया है; इसे जानकर मनुष्य ज्ञानी हो जाता है और उसके सब कर्तव्य पूर्ण हो जाते हैं।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्
verses.tr:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
abhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ
dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness.
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Fearlessness, clean living, unceasing concentration on wisdom, readiness to give, self-control, a spirit of sacrifice, regular study of the scriptures, austerity, candor,
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: निर्भयता, हृदय की शुद्धता, ज्ञान और योग में दृढ़ता, दान, इन्द्रियों का संयम, यज्ञ, शास्त्रों का अध्ययन, तप और सरलता,

verses.sa: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्
verses.tr:
ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam
dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam
verses.en: Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness.
verses.en2: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, contentment, straightforwardness, compassion towards all, uncovetousness, courtesy, modesty, and constancy.
verses.hi: अहिंसा, सत्य, क्रोध का अभाव, त्याग, शान्ति, कुटिलता का अभाव, प्राणियों पर दया, लोभ का अभाव, कोमलता, लज्जा और चंचलता का अभाव,

verses.sa:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत
verses.tr:
tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā
bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
verses.en: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, O Arjuna.
verses.en2: Valor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from hate and vanity—these are the qualities of one who possesses the divine, O Arjuna!
verses.hi: तेज, क्षमा, धैर्य, पवित्रता, द्वेष का अभाव और अभिमान का अभाव: हे अर्जुन, ये दैवी सम्पदा लेकर जन्मे व्यक्ति के गुण हैं।

verses.sa: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्
verses.tr:
dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha
ajñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm
verses.en: Hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, O Partha.
verses.en2: Hypocrisy, pride, insolence, cruelty, and ignorance belong to those born of godless qualities.
verses.hi: हे पार्थ, दम्भ, घमण्ड, अहंकार, क्रोध, कठोरता और अज्ञान: ये आसुरी सम्पदा लेकर जन्मे व्यक्ति के लक्षण हैं।

verses.sa: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव
verses.tr:
daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava
verses.en: The divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. Grieve not, O Arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments.
verses.en2: Godly qualities lead to liberation; godless ones lead to bondage. Do not be anxious, Prince! You have the Godly qualities.
verses.hi: दैवी सम्पदा मुक्ति देने वाली और आसुरी सम्पदा बन्धन में डालने वाली मानी गई है। हे अर्जुन, शोक मत करो, क्योंकि तुम दैवी सम्पदा लेकर जन्मे हो।

verses.sa: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु
verses.tr:
dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha
daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu
verses.en: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been described at length; hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniacal.
verses.hi: इस संसार में दो प्रकार के प्राणी हैं: दैवी और आसुरी। दैवी का वर्णन विस्तार से हो चुका है; हे अर्जुन, अब मुझसे आसुरी के विषय में सुनो।

verses.sa: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
verses.tr:
pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ
na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate
verses.en: The demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth.
verses.en2: The godless do not know how to act or renounce; they lack both purity and truth. They do not understand the right principles of conduct.
verses.hi: आसुरी स्वभाव वाले लोग नहीं जानते कि क्या करना चाहिए और किससे दूर रहना चाहिए; उनमें न पवित्रता है, न सदाचार, न सत्य।

verses.sa: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्
verses.tr:
asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram
aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam
verses.en: They say, "This universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a God, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"
verses.en2: They say the universe is an accident with no purpose and no God. Life is created through sexual union, a product of lust and nothing else.
verses.hi: वे कहते हैं: यह संसार सत्य से रहित है, इसका कोई नैतिक आधार नहीं, कोई ईश्वर नहीं, यह केवल आपसी संयोग से उत्पन्न हुआ है और कामना ही इसका कारण है; इसके सिवा और क्या है?

verses.sa: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः
verses.tr:
etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ
prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ
verses.en: Holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world, intent on its destruction.
verses.en2: Thinking thus, these degraded souls, these enemies of mankind—whose intelligence is negligible and whose deeds are monstrous—come into the world only to destroy.
verses.hi: इस दृष्टि को पकड़कर, ये नष्ट आत्मा वाले, अल्पबुद्धि और क्रूर कर्म करने वाले लोग संसार के शत्रु बनकर उसके विनाश के लिए उत्पन्न होते हैं।

verses.sa: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः
verses.tr:
kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ
mohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ
verses.en: Filled with insatiable desires, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding evil ideas due to delusion, they work with impure intentions.
verses.en2: Giving themselves up to insatiable passions, hypocritically, self-sufficiently, and arrogantly, cherishing false conceptions founded on delusion, they work only to carry out their own unholy purposes.
verses.hi: कभी पूरी न होने वाली कामनाओं से भरे, दम्भ, मान और मद में डूबे, मोह के कारण बुरे विचारों को पकड़े हुए वे अपवित्र संकल्पों के साथ काम करते हैं।

verses.sa: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः
verses.tr:
chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ
kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ
verses.en: Giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death, regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim, and feeling sure that that is all.
verses.en2: Poring anxiously over evil resolutions that only end in death, seeking only the gratification of desire as the highest goal, and seeing nothing beyond—
verses.hi: मृत्यु तक समाप्त न होने वाली असीम चिन्ताओं में डूबे, कामनाओं की पूर्ति को ही अपना परम लक्ष्य मानकर, और यह निश्चय करके कि बस यही सब कुछ है,

verses.sa: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्
verses.tr:
āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān
verses.en: Bound by a hundred ties of hope, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment.
verses.en2: Caught in the toils of a hundred vain hopes, enslaved by passion and wrath, they accumulate hoards of unjust wealth, only to indulge their sensual desires.
verses.hi: आशा के सैकड़ों बन्धनों में बँधे, काम और क्रोध के वश में होकर, वे इन्द्रिय-भोग के लिए अन्याय से धन के ढेर इकट्ठा करने का प्रयत्न करते हैं।

verses.sa: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्
verses.tr:
idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham
idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam
verses.en: "I have gained this today; I will fulfill this desire of mine; this is mine, and this wealth will be mine in the future."
verses.en2: Today I have gained this; tomorrow I will fulfill another desire; this wealth is mine now, and the rest will soon be mine.
verses.hi: आज मैंने यह पा लिया है; अब मैं अपनी यह इच्छा पूरी करूँगा; यह मेरा है, और यह धन भी आगे मेरा हो जाएगा।

verses.sa: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी
verses.tr:
asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api
īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī
verses.en: "I have slain that enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord; I enjoy, I am perfect, powerful, and happy."
verses.en2: I have slain one enemy; I will slay the others too. I am worthy of enjoying; I am the Almighty, perfect, powerful, and happy.
verses.hi: उस शत्रु को मैंने मार डाला है, और दूसरों को भी मारूँगा। मैं ही स्वामी हूँ, मैं ही भोगने वाला हूँ, मैं सिद्ध, बलवान और सुखी हूँ।

verses.sa: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः
verses.tr:
āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā
yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ
aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau
verses.en: "I am wealthy and born into a noble family. Who is my equal? I shall perform sacrifices, give charity, and rejoice," thus deluded by ignorance.
verses.en2: I am wealthy, I am of noble birth; who can compare with me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will pay—and I will enjoy. Thus blinded by ignorance,
verses.hi: मैं धनवान हूँ और ऊँचे कुल में जन्मा हूँ। मेरे समान और कौन है? मैं यज्ञ करूँगा, दान दूँगा और आनन्द मनाऊँगा: इस प्रकार वे अज्ञान से मोहित रहते हैं।

verses.sa: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ
verses.tr: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau
verses.en: Bewildered by many fancies, entangled in the snare of delusion, addicted to the gratification of lust, they fall into a foul hell.
verses.en2: Perplexed by discordant thoughts, entangled in the snares of desire, infatuated by passion, they sink into the depths of hell.
verses.hi: अनेक कल्पनाओं से भ्रमित, मोह के जाल में फँसे और कामनाओं की पूर्ति में डूबे हुए वे घोर नरक में गिरते हैं।

verses.sa: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.tr:
ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ
yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam
wm: with no regards to the rules of the scriptures
verses.en: Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinances.
verses.en2: Self-conceited, stubborn, wealthy, proud, and insolent, they make a show of their patronage, disregarding the norms of propriety.
verses.hi: अपने को ही बड़ा मानने वाले, हठी, धन के मान और मद से भरे हुए वे शास्त्र-विधि के विरुद्ध केवल दिखावे के लिए नाममात्र के यज्ञ करते हैं।

verses.sa: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः
verses.tr:
ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ
mām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ
wm: within one’s own and bodies of others
verses.en: Given over to egoism, power, haughtiness, lust, and anger, these malicious people hate Me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.
verses.en2: Puffed up by power and inordinate conceit, swayed by lust and wrath, these wicked people hate Me, Who am within them as I am within all.
verses.hi: अहंकार, बल, घमण्ड, काम और क्रोध के वश में होकर, ये द्वेषी लोग अपने और दूसरों के शरीर में स्थित मुझसे द्वेष करते हैं।

verses.sa: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु
verses.tr:
tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān
kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu
wm: the vile and vicious of humankind
verses.en: Those cruel haters, the worst among men in the world, I hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only.
verses.en2: Those who thus hate Me, who are cruel, the dregs of mankind, I condemn them to a continuous, miserable, and godless rebirth.
verses.hi: उन क्रूर, द्वेष करने वाले, संसार में सबसे अधम मनुष्यों को, उन दुष्कर्मियों को मैं बार-बार आसुरी योनियों में ही डालता हूँ।

verses.sa: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
verses.tr:
āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim
verses.en: Entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded, birth after birth, they do not attain Me, thus falling, O Arjuna, into a condition still lower than that.
verses.en2: So, reborn, they spend life after life enveloped in delusion, and they never reach Me, O Prince, but degenerate into even lower forms of life.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, आसुरी योनियों में जन्म लेकर, जन्म-जन्म में मोहित रहते हुए वे मुझे प्राप्त नहीं करते, और इस प्रकार उससे भी नीची गति में गिरते हैं।

verses.sa: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
verses.tr:
tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet
verses.en: There are three gates to this hell, destructive of the self: lust, anger, and greed; therefore, one should abandon these three.
verses.en2: The gates of hell are three: lust, wrath, and avarice; they destroy the Self, so avoid them.
verses.hi: आत्मा का नाश करने वाले इस नरक के तीन द्वार हैं: काम, क्रोध और लोभ; इसलिए इन तीनों का त्याग कर देना चाहिए।

verses.sa: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.tr:
etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ
ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
verses.en: A person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness, O Arjuna, practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the Supreme Goal.
verses.en2: These are the gates that lead to darkness; if one avoids them, they will ensure their own welfare and eventually attain liberation.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, अन्धकार के इन तीन द्वारों से मुक्त हुआ मनुष्य अपने कल्याण का आचरण करता है और इस प्रकार परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sa: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
verses.tr:
yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ
na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim
verses.en: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the Supreme Goal.
verses.en2: But he who neglects the commands of the scriptures and follows the promptings of passion does not attain perfection, happiness, or the final goal.
verses.hi: जो शास्त्र-विधि को छोड़कर कामना की प्रेरणा से काम करता है, वह न सिद्धि पाता है, न सुख, न परम गति।

verses.sa: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.tr:
tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau
jñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi
verses.en: Therefore, let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. Having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures, thou shouldst act in this world.
verses.en2: Therefore, whenever there is doubt as to whether you should do something or not, let the scriptures guide your conduct. In the light of the scriptures, you should labor your whole life.
verses.hi: इसलिए क्या करना चाहिए और क्या नहीं, इसका निर्णय करने में शास्त्र को ही प्रमाण मानो। शास्त्र-विधि में जो कहा गया है उसे जानकर तुम्हें इस संसार में कर्म करना चाहिए।

verses.sa: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
ye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ
verses.en: Arjuna said, "What is the condition of those who, disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures, perform sacrifice with faith—is it Sattva, Rajas, or Tamas, O Krishna?"
verses.en2: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is the condition of those who perform acts of sacrifice not according to the scriptures, but with implicit faith? Is it one of purity, passion, or ignorance?"
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे कृष्ण, जो लोग शास्त्र की विधि की उपेक्षा करके श्रद्धा के साथ यज्ञ करते हैं, उनकी स्थिति कैसी है: सत्त्व, रजस या तमस?

verses.sa: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु
verses.tr:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā
sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "There are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied: the sattvic (pure), the rajasic (passionate), and the tamasic (dark). Hear of them."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Man has an inherent faith in one or another of the qualities—purity, passion, and ignorance. Now, listen.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: देहधारियों के स्वभाव से उत्पन्न श्रद्धा तीन प्रकार की होती है: सात्त्विक (शुद्ध), राजसी (आवेगपूर्ण) और तामसी (अन्धकारमय)। इनके विषय में सुनो।

verses.sa: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः
verses.tr:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata
śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
wm: conforming to the nature of one’s mind
whatever the nature of their faith
verses.en: The faith of each is in accordance with their nature, O Arjuna. People consist of their faith; as a person's faith is, so are they.
verses.en2: Every person's faith conforms to their nature. By nature, they are full of faith. They are, in fact, what their faith makes them.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, हर व्यक्ति की श्रद्धा उसके स्वभाव के अनुरूप होती है। मनुष्य श्रद्धामय है; जिसकी जैसी श्रद्धा है, वह वैसा ही है।

verses.sa: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः
verses.tr:
yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ
pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
wm: those in the mode of goodness
semi-celestial beings who exude power and wealth
powerful beings who embody sensual enjoyment, revenge, and wrath
those in the mode of passion
those in the mode of ignorance
verses.en: The sattvic, or pure, men worship the gods; the rajasic, or passionate, worship the yakshas and rakshasas; the others, the tamasic or deluded people, worship ghosts and hosts of nature-spirits.
verses.en2: The pure worship the true God; the passionate, the powers of wealth and magic; the ignorant, the spirits of the dead and lower orders of nature.
verses.hi: सात्त्विक लोग देवताओं की पूजा करते हैं; राजसी लोग यक्षों और राक्षसों की पूजा करते हैं; और बाकी, तामसी या मोहग्रस्त लोग, प्रेतों और भूतगणों की पूजा करते हैं।

verses.sa: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः
verses.tr:
aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
dambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ
verses.en: Those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures, given to hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of lust and attachment.
verses.en2: Those who practice austerities not commanded by scripture, who are enslaved to hypocrisy and egotism, who are carried away by the fury of desire and passion,
verses.hi: जो लोग शास्त्रों में न बताए गए घोर तप करते हैं, दम्भ और अहंकार से युक्त हैं, और काम तथा आसक्ति के बल से प्रेरित हैं,

verses.sa: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्
verses.tr:
karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ
māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān
verses.en: Know thou these to be of demonical resolves, senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and Me who dwell in the body.
verses.en2: They are ignorant and torment the organs of the body, harassing Me who lives within. Know that they are devoted to evil.
verses.hi: जो शरीर में स्थित सब तत्वों को और शरीर के भीतर रहने वाले मुझको भी बिना समझे कष्ट देते हैं, उन्हें तुम आसुरी निश्चय वाला जानो।

verses.sa: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
verses.tr:
āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ
yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu
verses.en: The food that is dear to each is threefold, as well as sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Hear the distinction of these.
verses.en2: The food that people enjoy is also threefold, like the ways of sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Listen to the distinction.
verses.hi: हर व्यक्ति को प्रिय लगने वाला भोजन भी तीन प्रकार का होता है, और वैसे ही यज्ञ, तप और दान भी। इनका भेद सुनो।

verses.sa: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
verses.tr:
āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ
wm: dear to those in the mode of goodness
verses.en: The foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, joy, and cheerfulness (good appetite), which are savory, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to the Sattvic (pure) people.
verses.en2: The foods that prolong life, increase purity, vigour, health, cheerfulness, and happiness are those that are delicious, soothing, substantial, and agreeable; these are loved by the pure.
verses.hi: जो भोजन आयु, सात्त्विकता, बल, स्वास्थ्य, सुख और प्रसन्नता (अच्छी भूख) को बढ़ाते हैं, जो रसीले, स्निग्ध, पौष्टिक और मन को भाने वाले हैं, वे सात्त्विक लोगों को प्रिय होते हैं।

verses.sa: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः
verses.tr:
kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣhṇa- tīkṣhṇa-rūkṣha-vidāhinaḥ
āhārā rājasasyeṣhṭā duḥkha-śhokāmaya-pradāḥ
wm: to persons in the mode of passion
verses.en: The foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning are liked by the Rajasic and are productive of pain, grief, and disease.
verses.en2: Those in whom passion is dominant like foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning. These produce unhappiness, repentance, and disease.
verses.hi: जो भोजन कड़वे, खट्टे, नमकीन, बहुत गरम, तीखे, रूखे और जलन पैदा करने वाले हैं, वे राजसी लोगों को पसन्द आते हैं और दुख, शोक तथा रोग उत्पन्न करते हैं।

verses.sa: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्
verses.tr:
yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat
uchchhiṣhṭam api chāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam
wm: to persons in the mode of ignorance
verses.en: That which is stale, tasteless, putrid, rotten, rejected, and impure is the food liked by the Tamasic.
verses.en2: The ignorant love food that is stale, not nourishing, putrid, and corrupt; the leftovers of others, and unclean.
verses.hi: जो भोजन बासी, स्वादहीन, दुर्गन्धयुक्त, सड़ा हुआ, जूठा और अपवित्र है, वह तामसी लोगों को पसन्द आता है।

verses.sa: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः
verses.tr:
aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yajño vidhi-driṣhṭo ya ijyate
yaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
wm: that is in accordance with the scriptural injunctions
verses.en: That sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward, as enjoined by the ordinance (scripture), with a firm faith that doing so is their duty, is Sattvic or pure.
verses.en2: Sacrifice is pure when it is offered by one who does not covet the fruit of it, when it is done according to the commands of scripture, and with implicit faith that the sacrifice is a duty.
verses.hi: जो यज्ञ शास्त्र-विधि के अनुसार, फल की इच्छा के बिना, इस दृढ़ विश्वास के साथ किया जाता है कि इसे करना कर्तव्य है, वह सात्त्विक या शुद्ध है।

verses.sa: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.tr:
abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat
ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam
wm: Arjun, the best of the Bharatas
verses.en: The sacrifice that is offered, O Arjuna, seeking a reward and for show, know that to be a Rajasic Yajna.
verses.en2: Sacrifice which is performed for the sake of its results, or for self-glorification - that, O best of Aryans, is the product of passion.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जो यज्ञ फल की इच्छा से और दिखावे के लिए किया जाता है, उसे राजसी यज्ञ जानो।

verses.sa: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते
verses.tr:
vidhi-hīnam asṛiṣhṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣhiṇam
śhraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ parichakṣhate
wm: with no chanting of the Vedic hymns
with no remunerations to the priests
verses.en: They declare that sacrifice to be Tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures, in which no food is distributed, and which is devoid of mantras, gifts, and faith.
verses.en2: Sacrifice that is contrary to scriptural command, that is unaccompanied by prayers or gifts of food or money, and is without faith—that is the product of ignorance.
verses.hi: जो यज्ञ शास्त्र-विधि के विरुद्ध है, जिसमें अन्न का वितरण नहीं होता, और जो मन्त्र, दक्षिणा और श्रद्धा से रहित है, उसे तामसी यज्ञ कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते
verses.tr:
deva-dwija-guru-prājña- pūjanaṁ śhaucham ārjavam
brahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate
verses.en: Worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body.
verses.en2: Worship of God and the Master; respect for the preacher and the philosopher; purity, rectitude, continence, and harmlessness—all of these constitute physical austerity.
verses.hi: देवताओं, द्विजों, गुरुओं और ज्ञानियों का पूजन, पवित्रता, सरलता, ब्रह्मचर्य और अहिंसा: इन्हें शरीर का तप कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते
verses.tr:
anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat
svādhyāyābhyasanaṁ chaiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa uchyate
verses.en: Speech that causes no excitement, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial; the practice of studying the Vedas is called austerity of speech.
verses.en2: Speech that hurts no one, that is true, pleasant to listen to, and beneficial, and the constant study of the scriptures—this is austerity of speech.
verses.hi: जो वाणी उद्वेग पैदा न करे, सच्ची हो, प्रिय हो और हितकारी हो, और वेदों के अध्ययन का अभ्यास: इसे वाणी का तप कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते
verses.tr:
manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
bhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate
verses.en: Serenity of mind, good-heartedness, self-control, and purity of nature—this is called mental austerity.
verses.en2: Serenity, kindness, silence, self-control, and purity—these are the austerities of the mind.
verses.hi: मन की प्रसन्नता, सौम्यता, आत्मसंयम और भावों की पवित्रता: इसे मन का तप कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ति्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते
verses.tr:
śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ
aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ parichakṣhate
verses.en: This threefold austerity, practiced by steadfast men, with the utmost faith, desiring no reward, is called Sattvic.
verses.en2: These threefold austerities, performed with faith and without thought of reward, can truly be considered pure.
verses.hi: फल की इच्छा न रखने वाले, दृढ़ मनुष्य जब परम श्रद्धा के साथ यह तीन प्रकार का तप करते हैं, तो उसे सात्त्विक कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्
verses.tr:
satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena chaiva yat
kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam
verses.en: The austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is said to be Rajasic, unstable, and transient.
verses.en2: Austerity coupled with hypocrisy, or performed for the sake of self-glorification, popularity, or vanity, comes from passion, and its result is always uncertain and temporary.
verses.hi: जो तप सत्कार, मान और पूजा पाने के उद्देश्य से और दिखावे के साथ किया जाता है, उसे राजसी, अस्थिर और क्षणिक कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.tr:
mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ
parasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.en: That austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying another, is declared to be of the Tamasic nature.
verses.en2: Austerity done under delusion, and accompanied with sorcery or the infliction of pain upon oneself or another, may be assumed to spring from ignorance.
verses.hi: जो तप मूर्खतापूर्ण विचार से, अपने को कष्ट देकर, या किसी दूसरे का नाश करने के उद्देश्य से किया जाता है, उसे तामसी कहा गया है।

verses.sa: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
verses.tr:
dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe
deśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam
wm: to one who cannot give in return
verses.en: That gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person, is held to be Sattvic.
verses.en2: The gift that is given without thought of recompense, believing it should be made, in an appropriate place, at an opportune time, and to a deserving person—such a gift is pure.
verses.hi: जो दान यह समझकर कि देना कर्तव्य है, उचित स्थान और समय पर, किसी योग्य व्यक्ति को दिया जाता है जो बदले में कुछ नहीं करता, उसे सात्त्विक माना गया है।

verses.sa: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
verses.tr:
yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ
dīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam
wm: with the hope of a return
verses.en: And, that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return, or expecting a reward, or begrudgingly, is considered to be Rajasic.
verses.en2: That which is given for the sake of the results it will produce, or with the hope of recompense, or grudgingly—that may truly be said to be the outcome of passion.
verses.hi: और जो दान बदले में कुछ पाने के उद्देश्य से, फल की आशा से, या अनिच्छा से दिया जाता है, उसे राजसी माना जाता है।

verses.sa: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.tr:
adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate
asat-kṛitam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.en: The gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, is declared to be of a Tamasic nature.
verses.en2: And that which is given at an inappropriate place or time or to one who is undeserving, or with disrespect or contempt - such a gift is the result of ignorance.
verses.hi: जो दान गलत स्थान पर, गलत समय पर, अयोग्य व्यक्तियों को, बिना आदर के या अपमान के साथ दिया जाता है, उसे तामसी कहा गया है।

verses.sa: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
verses.tr:
oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ
brāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā
verses.en: "Om Tat Sat": This has been declared to be the triple designation of Brahman. By that, the Brahmanas, the Vedas, and the sacrifices were created formerly.
verses.en2: Om Tat Sat is the triple designation of the Eternal Spirit, by which the Vedic Scriptures, ceremonials, and sacrifices were ordained of old.
verses.hi: ॐ तत् सत्: इसे ब्रह्म का तीन प्रकार का नाम बताया गया है। इसी से प्राचीन काल में ब्राह्मण, वेद और यज्ञ रचे गए।

verses.sa: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.tr:
tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām
wm: according to the prescriptions of Vedic injunctions
verses.en: Therefore, with the utterance of "Om," the acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, are always begun by the students of Brahman.
verses.en2: Therefore, all acts of sacrifice, gifts, and austerities prescribed by the scriptures are always begun by those who understand the Spirit with the word "Om."
verses.hi: इसलिए ब्रह्म के साधक शास्त्रों में बताए गए यज्ञ, दान और तप के कर्म सदा ॐ का उच्चारण करके ही आरम्भ करते हैं।

verses.sa: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि
verses.tr:
tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
dāna-kriyāśh cha vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣha-kāṅkṣhibhiḥ
wm: by seekers of freedom from material entanglements
verses.en: Uttering "Tat," without aiming for the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice, austerity, and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation.
verses.en2: Those who desire deliverance begin their acts of sacrifice, austerity, or gift with the word "Tat" (meaning "That"), without thought of reward.
verses.hi: मुक्ति चाहने वाले लोग तत् का उच्चारण करके, फल की इच्छा के बिना, यज्ञ, तप और अनेक प्रकार के दान के कर्म करते हैं।

verses.sa: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
verses.tr:
sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate
praśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
wm: with the intention of eternal existence and goodness
verses.en: The word "Sat" is used to refer to reality and goodness; likewise, O Arjuna, the word "Sat" is used to refer to an auspicious act.
verses.en2: Sat' means Reality or the highest Good, and also, O Arjuna, it is used to denote an action of exceptional merit.
verses.hi: सत् शब्द का प्रयोग सत्य और श्रेष्ठता के अर्थ में होता है; इसी प्रकार, हे अर्जुन, शुभ कर्म के लिए भी सत् शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

verses.sa: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते
verses.tr:
yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate
karma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate
verses.en: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and gift is also called 'Sat', and action in connection with these, or for the sake of the Supreme, is also called 'Sat'.
verses.en2: Conviction in sacrifice, austerity, and giving is also called Sat. So too, an action done only for the Lord's sake.
verses.hi: यज्ञ, तप और दान में दृढ़ता को भी सत् कहा जाता है, और इनसे जुड़ा कर्म, या परमेश्वर के लिए किया गया कर्म भी सत् कहलाता है।

verses.sa: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
verses.tr:
aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat
asad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha
verses.en: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practiced without faith, it is called 'Asat', O Arjuna; it is of no value here or hereafter (after death).
verses.en2: Whatever is done without faith, whether it be sacrifice, austerity, gift, or anything else, is called Asat (meaning "Unreal"), for it is the negation of Sat, O Arjuna! Such an act has no significance, here or hereafter.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, बिना श्रद्धा के जो भी हवन किया जाता है, दान दिया जाता है, कर्म किया जाता है या तप किया जाता है, वह असत् कहलाता है; उसका न इस लोक में कोई मूल्य है, न मृत्यु के बाद।

verses.sa:
अर्जुन उवाच
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन
verses.tr:
arjuna uvācha
sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum
tyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana
wm: of renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
Krishna, the Lord of the senses
Krishna, the killer of the Keshi demon
verses.en: Arjuna said, "O mighty-armed Hrishikesa, I desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally, O slayer of Kesi."
verses.en2: Arjuna asked, "O Mighty One! I desire to know how relinquishment is distinguished from renunciation.
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे महाबाहु हृषीकेश, हे केशी का वध करने वाले, मैं संन्यास और त्याग, दोनों का अलग-अलग सार या सत्य जानना चाहता हूँ।

verses.sa:
श्री भगवानुवाच
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः
verses.tr:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ
sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vichakṣhaṇāḥ
wm: renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: The Blessed Lord said, "The sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire; the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga."
verses.en2: Lord Shri Krishna replied: The sages say that renunciation is forgoing an action that springs from desire, and relinquishing is the surrender of its fruit.
verses.hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: ज्ञानी जन कामना से किए जाने वाले कर्मों के त्याग को संन्यास समझते हैं; और विवेकी लोग सभी कर्मों के फल के त्याग को त्याग कहते हैं।

verses.sa:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे
verses.tr:
tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti chāpare
verses.en: Some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil; while others declare that acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be relinquished.
verses.en2: Some philosophers say that all action is evil and should be abandoned, whereas others maintain that acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up.
verses.hi: कुछ विचारक कहते हैं कि कर्मों को दोषपूर्ण मानकर छोड़ देना चाहिए; जबकि दूसरे कहते हैं कि यज्ञ, दान और तप रूपी कर्मों को नहीं छोड़ना चाहिए।

verses.sa: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
verses.tr:
niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama
tyāgo hi puruṣha-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ
wm: about renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: Hear from Me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment, O best of the Bharatas; abandonment, indeed, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.
verses.en2: O best of Indians! Listen to my judgment regarding this problem. It has a threefold aspect.
verses.hi: हे भरतश्रेष्ठ, इस त्याग के विषय में मेरा निर्णय या अंतिम सत्य सुनो; हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ, त्याग वास्तव में तीन प्रकार का बताया गया है।

verses.sa: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्
verses.tr:
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat
yajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām
verses.en: Acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be abandoned, but should be performed; for sacrifice, gift, and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.
verses.en2: Acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up, but should be performed, for they purify the aspiring soul.
verses.hi: यज्ञ, दान और तप के कर्मों को छोड़ना नहीं चाहिए, बल्कि उन्हें करना चाहिए; क्योंकि यज्ञ, दान और तप विवेकी जनों को पवित्र करने वाले हैं।

verses.sa: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम्
verses.tr:
etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha
kartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam
verses.en: But even these actions should be performed, leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards, O Arjuna; this is my certain and most assured conviction.
verses.en2: But they should be done with detachment and without thought of reward. This is my final judgement.
verses.hi: परंतु हे अर्जुन, इन कर्मों को भी आसक्ति और फल की इच्छा छोड़कर करना चाहिए; यह मेरा निश्चित और सबसे दृढ़ मत है।

verses.sa: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः
verses.tr:
niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate
mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.en: Verily, the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper; the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be Tamasic.
verses.en2: It is not right to give up actions which are obligatory; and if they are misunderstood, it is the result of sheer ignorance.
verses.hi: निश्चय ही, नियत (अनिवार्य) कर्म का त्याग उचित नहीं है; मोहवश उसका त्याग करना तामसिक कहा गया है।

verses.sa: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
verses.tr:
duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet
sa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet
wm: renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: He who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble (because it is painful), does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such Rajasic renunciation.
verses.en2: To avoid an action out of fear of physical suffering, as it is likely to be painful, is to act out of passion, and the benefit of renunciation will not be gained.
verses.hi: जो व्यक्ति कर्म को दुःखदायक समझकर शारीरिक कष्ट के भय से छोड़ देता है, वह ऐसा राजसिक त्याग करके त्याग का फल प्राप्त नहीं करता।

verses.sa: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन।सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
verses.tr:
kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna
saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ chaiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
wm: renunciation of desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: Whatever obligatory action is done, O Arjuna, merely because it ought to be done, abandoning attachment and also the desire for reward, that renunciation is regarded as sattvic (pure).
verses.en2: He who performs an obligatory action, believing it to be a duty that ought to be done, without any personal desire to do the act or to receive any return—such renunciation is pure.
verses.hi: हे अर्जुन, जो नियत कर्म केवल इसलिए किया जाता है कि उसे करना कर्तव्य है, और आसक्ति तथा फल की इच्छा भी छोड़ दी जाती है, वह त्याग सात्त्विक (शुद्ध) माना जाता है।

verses.sa: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः
verses.tr:
na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate
tyāgī sattva-samāviṣhṭo medhāvī chhinna-sanśhayaḥ
wm: one who renounces desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: The man of renunciation, pervaded by purity, intelligent, and with his doubts cut asunder, does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one.
verses.en2: The wise man who has attained purity, whose doubts are resolved, who is filled with the spirit of self-abnegation, does not shy away from action due to its pain, nor does he crave it due to its pleasure.
verses.hi: सत्त्व से परिपूर्ण, बुद्धिमान और जिसके संशय कट चुके हैं, ऐसा त्यागी पुरुष न अप्रिय कार्य से द्वेष करता है और न प्रिय कार्य में आसक्त होता है।

verses.sa: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते
verses.tr:
na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ
yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate
wm: one who renounces all desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
one who renounces all desires for enjoying the fruits of actions
verses.en: Indeed, it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions; however, he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation.
verses.en2: But since those still in the body cannot entirely avoid action, in their case, the abandonment of the fruit of action is considered as complete renunciation.
verses.hi: वास्तव में, देहधारी प्राणी के लिए कर्मों को पूरी तरह छोड़ देना संभव नहीं है; किंतु जो कर्मों के फल का त्याग करता है, वही सच्चा त्यागी कहलाता है।

verses.sa: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
verses.tr:
aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit
wm: to those who are attached to persona reward
verses.en: The threefold fruit of action (evil, good, and mixed) accrues after death to those who do not abandon it, but never to those who do.
verses.en2: For those who cannot renounce all desires, the fruit of action hereafter is threefold—good, evil, and partly good and partly evil. But for him who has renounced, there is none.
verses.hi: कर्म का तीन प्रकार का फल (बुरा, अच्छा और मिश्रित) उन्हें मृत्यु के बाद प्राप्त होता है जिन्होंने फल का त्याग नहीं किया, परंतु त्याग करने वालों को कभी नहीं।

verses.sa: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्
verses.tr:
pañchaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me
sānkhye kṛitānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām
verses.en: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed Arjuna, these five causes, as declared in the Sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions.
verses.en2: I will now tell you, O Mighty Man, the five causes that must come together, according to the final decision of philosophy, for an action to be accomplished.
verses.hi: हे महाबाहु अर्जुन, सभी कर्मों की सिद्धि के ये पाँच कारण, जैसा कि सांख्य शास्त्र में बताया गया है, मुझसे जानो।

verses.sa: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्
verses.tr:
adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham
vividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam
verses.en: The body, the doer, the various senses, the different functions of various kinds, and the presiding deity—the fifth.
verses.en2: They have a body, a personality, physical organs, and manifold activities and destinies.
verses.hi: शरीर, कर्ता, विभिन्न इंद्रियाँ, अनेक प्रकार की अलग-अलग क्रियाएँ, और पाँचवाँ अधिष्ठाता देव।

verses.sa: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
verses.tr:
śharīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ
nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ
verses.en: Whatever action a person performs with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes.
verses.en2: Whatever action a person performs, whether by muscular effort, speech, or thought, and whether it be right or wrong, these five are the essential causes.
verses.hi: मनुष्य अपने शरीर, वाणी और मन से जो भी कर्म करता है, चाहे वह उचित हो या अनुचित, उसके ये पाँच कारण हैं।

verses.sa: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः
verses.tr:
tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ
paśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ
verses.en: Now, such being the case, verily he who, owing to an untrained understanding, looks upon his Self, which is isolated, as the agent, he of perverted intelligence does not see.
verses.en2: But the fool, who, due to his immature judgment, supposes that it is his own Self alone that acts, perverts the truth and does not see rightly.
verses.hi: ऐसा होने पर भी, जो व्यक्ति अप्रशिक्षित बुद्धि के कारण अपने असंग आत्मा को कर्ता मानता है, वह विकृत बुद्धि वाला यथार्थ को नहीं देखता।

verses.sa: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
verses.tr:
yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate
hatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate
wm: free from the ego of being the doer
verses.en: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil, though he slays these people, he does not slay, nor is he bound by the action.
verses.en2: He who has no pride and whose intellect is unalloyed by attachment, even though he kills these people, he does not kill them, and his act does not bind him.
verses.hi: जिसमें 'मैं कर्ता हूँ' का अहंभाव नहीं है और जिसकी बुद्धि शुभ या अशुभ से लिप्त नहीं होती, वह इन लोगों को मारकर भी न मारता है और न कर्म से बँधता है।

verses.sa: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः
verses.tr:
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā
karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ
verses.en: Knowledge, the knowable, and the knower form the threefold impulse for action; the organ, the action, and the agent form the threefold basis of action.
verses.en2: Knowledge, the knower, and the object of knowledge are the three incentives to action; and the act, the actor, and the instrument are the threefold constituents.
verses.hi: ज्ञान, ज्ञेय और ज्ञाता, ये तीन कर्म की प्रेरणा हैं; करण (साधन), क्रिया और कर्ता, ये तीन कर्म के आधार हैं।

verses.sa: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि
verses.tr:
jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ
prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api
wm: distinguished according to the three modes of material nature
Sānkhya philosophy, which describes the modes of material nature
verses.en: Knowledge, action, and actor are declared in the science of the Gunas (Sankhya philosophy) to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction of the Gunas. Of these, hear duly.
verses.en2: The knowledge, the action, and the doer differ according to their qualities. Listen to this as well.
verses.hi: गुणों के शास्त्र (सांख्य) में ज्ञान, कर्म और कर्ता को गुणों के भेद के अनुसार तीन-तीन प्रकार का ही बताया गया है। उन्हें भी ठीक-ठीक सुनो।

verses.sa: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्
verses.tr:
sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate
avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam
verses.en: That by which one sees the indestructible Reality in all beings, not separate in any of them—know that knowledge to be Sattvic.
verses.en2: That knowledge which sees the One Indestructible in all beings, the One Indivisible in all separate lives, can be truly called Pure Knowledge.
verses.hi: जिस ज्ञान से मनुष्य सभी प्राणियों में एक अविनाशी सत्ता को देखता है, जो विभक्त प्राणियों में भी अविभक्त है, उस ज्ञान को सात्त्विक जानो।

verses.sa: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.tr:
pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān
vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam
verses.en: But that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another, know thou that knowledge to be Rajasic.
verses.en2: The knowledge that perceives the manifold existence in all beings as separate comes from passion.
verses.hi: परंतु जो ज्ञान सभी प्राणियों में अलग-अलग प्रकार की अनेक सत्ताओं को एक-दूसरे से भिन्न देखता है, उस ज्ञान को तुम राजसिक जानो।

verses.sa: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.tr:
yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam
atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
wm: as if it encompasses the whole
verses.en: But that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without any foundation in Truth, and is trivial—that is declared to be Tamasic.
verses.en2: But that which clings blindly to one idea as if it were all, without logic, truth, or insight, has its origin in darkness.
verses.hi: और जो ज्ञान किसी एक ही कार्य में ऐसे चिपका रहता है मानो वही सब कुछ हो, जो तर्कहीन है, सत्य पर आधारित नहीं है और तुच्छ है, उसे तामसिक कहा गया है।

verses.sa: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते
verses.tr:
niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam
aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate
verses.en: An action that is ordained, free from attachment, done without love or hatred, and without desire for reward is declared to be Sattvic.
verses.en2: An obligatory action done by one who is disinterested, who neither likes nor dislikes it, and gives no thought to the consequences that may follow, such an action is Pure.
verses.hi: जो कर्म शास्त्रविहित है, आसक्ति से रहित है, बिना राग या द्वेष के किया गया है, और जिसमें फल की इच्छा नहीं है, वह सात्त्विक कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्
verses.tr:
yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ
kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam
verses.en: But that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be Rajasic (passionate).
verses.en2: But even though an action involves the most strenuous endeavor, yet if the doer is seeking to gratify their desires and is filled with personal vanity, it may be assumed to originate in passion.
verses.hi: परंतु जो कर्म कामनाओं की पूर्ति या लाभ की लालसा से, अहंकार के साथ या बहुत परिश्रम से किया जाता है, वह राजसिक कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते
verses.tr:
anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham
mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate
verses.en: That action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard for the consequences, loss, injury, and one's own ability, is declared to be Tamasic (dark).
verses.en2: An action undertaken through delusion, with no regard to the spiritual implications, the capacity of the doer, or the potential harm that may follow, is assumed to be a product of ignorance.
verses.hi: जो कर्म मोहवश, परिणाम, हानि, हिंसा और अपनी सामर्थ्य का विचार किए बिना आरंभ किया जाता है, वह तामसिक कहा जाता है।

verses.sa: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते
verses.tr:
mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ
siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate
verses.en: An agent who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with firmness and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure, is considered to be of a Sattvic (pure) nature.
verses.en2: But when a person has no sentiment or ego, when they possess courage and confidence, not caring whether they succeed or fail, then their action arises from purity.
verses.hi: जो कर्ता आसक्ति से मुक्त है, अहंकार रहित है, धैर्य और उत्साह से युक्त है, और सफलता या विफलता से अप्रभावित रहता है, वह सात्त्विक कहलाता है।

verses.sa: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः
